questions.en: How do I answer an MCQ that says "Choose TWO letters"?
questions.uz: MCQda “Choose TWO letters” yozilgan bo‘lsa, qanday javob beraman?

answer.uz: “Choose TWO letters” — aynan ikkita javob tanlang. Avval savol nimani so‘raganini belgilang, har variantni audio dalili bilan tekshiring, keyin ikki tanlov qolganini sanang. Misol: ikki qulaylik so‘ralsa, narx haqidagi gap uchinchi javob bo‘lib qolmaydi.
answer.en: “Choose TWO letters” requires exactly two selections. Identify the requested information, check each option against audio evidence, then count your selections. If two facilities are requested, a comment about price is not a third answer.

questions.en: What should I do when an MCQ asks me to choose THREE answers?
questions.uz: MCQda uchta javob tanlash talab qilinsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: “Choose THREE answers” — uchta javob kerak. Uchta tanlovning har biriga alohida dalil toping; shunchaki ketma-ket uch harfni olmang. Masalan, uch sabab so‘ralsa, sabab, natija va misolni bir xil deb hisoblamang.
answer.en: Choose exactly three supported answers. Find independent evidence for each; do not pick three consecutive letters. If the question asks for three causes, distinguish a cause from a consequence or an example.

questions.en: How can I tell whether an MCQ allows one or several answers?
questions.uz: MCQda bitta yoki bir nechta variant tanlash mumkinligini qayerdan bilaman?

answer.uz: Variantlar sonidan emas, savol ustidagi yo‘riqnomadan biling: “Choose ONE”, “Choose TWO” yoki “Choose THREE”. Belgilashdan oldin shu sonni yozib oling, yuborishdan oldin tanlangan javoblarni sanang. Yo‘riqnoma ko‘rinmasa, taxmin qilishdan oldin uni tekshiring.
answer.en: Read the instruction, not the number of available options: Choose ONE, TWO or THREE. Note that number before listening and count selections before submitting. If the instruction is missing, check it rather than guessing.

questions.en: How do I choose when two MCQ options both sound correct?
questions.uz: MCQda ikki variant ham to‘g‘ridek tuyulsa, qaysisini tanlayman?

answer.uz: Ikki variantning farqini bitta jumlada yozing: vaqtmi, sababmi yoki kimning fikrimi? Audio aynan qaysi farqni tasdiqlaganini tekshiring. “Arzon” va “qulay joyda” bir narsani anglatmaydi; spiker narxni aytgan bo‘lsa, joy haqidagi javobni qo‘shmang.
answer.en: Write the difference between the two options: time, reason or speaker? Listen for evidence resolving that difference. Cheap and conveniently located are different claims; mentioning price does not establish location.

questions.en: What if the speaker corrects an earlier answer in the audio?
questions.uz: Audio boshida aytilgan ma’lumot keyin tuzatilsa, MCQda qaysisini olaman?

answer.uz: Tuzatish aynan so‘ralgan ma’lumotga tegishli bo‘lsa, yakuniy tasdiqlangan shaklni oling. “Tuesday—sorry, Thursday”da Thursday qoladi. Lekin keyingi gap boshqa odam yoki boshqa rejaga tegishli bo‘lsa, birinchi javobni avtomatik almashtirmang.
answer.en: Use the final corrected information about the same requested fact. In “Tuesday—sorry, Thursday”, Thursday replaces Tuesday. A later sentence about a different person or plan does not automatically replace the earlier answer.

questions.en: How should I handle an MCQ asking which option was NOT mentioned?
questions.uz: MCQda “NOT mentioned” deyilsa, qanday ishlayman?

answer.uz: NOT mentioned — aytilmaganini topish. Har variant uchun “aytildi” yoki “dalil yo‘q” deb tekshiring; noto‘g‘ri deb aytilgan bilan umuman aytilmagan farq qiladi. Savoldagi NOTni oldindan belgilang, keyin tanlovni qayta o‘qing.
answer.en: NOT mentioned asks for information absent from the recording. Mark which options have evidence. Explicit rejection differs from no mention at all. Highlight NOT before listening and reread the instruction before choosing.

questions.en: How do I identify a speaker's final opinion after hesitation?
questions.uz: Spiker ikkilanib, oxirida fikrini o‘zgartirsa, yakuniy pozitsiyani qanday topaman?

answer.uz: “Maybe”, “I thought” dastlabki taxmin bo‘lishi mumkin; “actually”, “in the end”, “we decided” yakuniy qarorni ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Belgining o‘ziga emas, undan keyingi to‘liq fikrga tayaning. Oldingi va oxirgi pozitsiyani ikki ustunda yozing.
answer.en: Separate initial hesitation from the final position. Maybe or I thought may introduce an early idea; actually or we decided may signal revision. Check the complete statement and whose view it is, not a signal word alone.

questions.en: Why is an option containing the exact word from the audio not always correct?
questions.uz: Audiodagi aynan bir xil so‘z bor variant nega doim to‘g‘ri emas?

answer.uz: Bir xil so‘z — dalilning o‘zi emas. Variantdagi butun da’voni: kim, nima, qachon va inkorni solishtiring. “We considered the bus but took the train”da bus eshitildi, ammo tanlangan transport train. Kalit so‘z emas, ma’no mos bo‘lishi kerak.
answer.en: An identical word is not enough. Compare the full claim, including person, time and negation. “We considered the bus but took the train” mentions bus, but train is the chosen transport. Match meaning rather than isolated words.

questions.en: Should I read the MCQ stem or the options first?
questions.uz: MCQda avval savol matninimi yoki variantlarnimi o‘qiyman?

answer.uz: Avval savolning nimani so‘rashini o‘qing, keyin variantlar orasidagi farqni belgilang. Uzun variantlarni qisqa tayanchlarga aylantiring. Audio davomida barcha matnni qayta o‘qishga urinmang; savol va asosiy farqni kuzating.
answer.en: Read the stem to identify the task, then compare the options. Reduce long choices to brief distinguishing notes. During playback, follow the requested information instead of repeatedly rereading every option.

questions.en: How do I listen for an answer when the options are long sentences?
questions.uz: MCQ variantlari uzun gaplardan iborat bo‘lsa, qanday tinglayman?

answer.uz: Har variantni 2–4 so‘zli ma’no tayanchiga qisqartiring: “price too high”, “location inconvenient”, “no weekend service”. Raqam, inkor va cheklovni saqlang. Tinglayotganda shu farqlarga dalil izlang, so‘zma-so‘z moslikka emas.
answer.en: Reduce each option to a short meaning cue, preserving numbers, negation and qualifiers: price too high, inconvenient location, no weekend service. Listen for the distinction rather than exact wording.

questions.en: What should I note beside the options while listening to an MCQ?
questions.uz: MCQ tinglayotganda variantlar yoniga qanday qisqa belgi qo‘yaman?

answer.uz: O‘zingiz uchun ✓ — tasdiq, × — rad, ? — hali dalil yo‘q belgilarini ishlating. Yoniga qisqa sabab yozing: “too expensive”, “changed plan”. ? ni to‘g‘ri javob deb olmang; bu faqat hali tekshirilmagan variant.
answer.en: Use brief personal notes: ✓ supported, × rejected, ? unresolved. Add a short reason such as too expensive or changed plan. A question mark means insufficient evidence, not a correct answer.

questions.en: How can I review my MCQ answers without memorising the answer key?
questions.uz: MCQni tekshirgach, javobni yodlamasdan xatoni qanday tahlil qilaman?

answer.uz: Xato variantni nega tanlaganingizni yozing, keyin audiodagi hal qiluvchi gap va to‘g‘ri variantning ma’nosini solishtiring. Xatoni “inkorni o‘tkazdim”, “eski qarorni oldim”, “bir xil so‘zga aldandim” deb nomlang. Keyingi urinishda shu turdagi dalilni qidiring.
answer.en: Record why you chose the wrong option, locate the decisive sentence, and compare its meaning with the correct choice. Label the error: missed negation, earlier decision or word matching. Practise detecting that error instead of memorising the key.

answer.uz: Avval yo‘riqnomada bitta yoki ikki tanlov so‘ralganini tekshiring. Ikki javob aniq talab qilinib, ikkinchisi birinchisini o‘chirsa, bu interfeys xatosi bo‘lishi mumkin. Savol nomi, qurilma va ko‘rinadigan yo‘riqnoma bilan Supportga xabar bering; tugallanmagan javobni avval saqlang.
answer.en: Check whether the instruction requires one or two choices. If two are required but selecting the second clears the first, report a possible interface mismatch with the item, device and visible instruction. Preserve unfinished work before leaving.

answer.uz: Topshirishdan oldin yangi variantni tanlang; ko‘p tanlovli savolda avval ortiqcha tanlovni olib tashlash talab qilinishi mumkin. Yuborishdan oldin saqlangan tanlovni qayta ko‘ring. Topshirilgan urinishni o‘zgartirish imkonini esa sahifadagi holat belgilaydi.
answer.en: Before submission, select the replacement; a multiple-selection item may require deselecting an extra choice first. Recheck the saved selection. Whether a submitted attempt can be changed depends on its actual state and controls.

answer.en: Scroll within the question, dismiss the keyboard and check browser zoom. Confirm the selected option before submitting. If an option remains obscured, report the page and device with a screenshot rather than guessing an unseen choice.

questions.en: How do I distinguish B, D and P when someone spells a name aloud?
questions.uz: Listeningda ism harflab aytilganda B, D va P ni qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Harf nomlarini farqlang: B /biː/, D /diː/, P /piː/. P boshida havo kuchliroq chiqadi; B va Dning boshlang‘ich tovushi boshqa. Avval B–D, B–P juftlarini, keyin qisqa harflangan ismlarni yozib mashq qiling. Kontekst va qayta aytilgan spellingni tekshiring.
answer.en: Practise letter names B /biː/, D /diː/ and P /piː/. Their initial consonants differ; P often has a stronger puff of air. Start with pairs, then short spelled names, and verify using repeated spelling and context.

answer.uz: Tuzatilgan raqamni faqat bir xil telefon raqamiga tegishli bo‘lsa almashtiring. “018—sorry, 081”da oxirgi uch raqam 081. Raqamlarni kichik guruhlarda yozing, tuzatilgan guruh ustidan belgilang va yakunida butun raqamni tekshiring.
answer.en: Replace only the corrected part of the same number. In “018—sorry, 081”, use 081 for that group. Write numbers in small chunks, mark the revised chunk and check the complete final number.

answer.uz: Standart Listening yo‘riqnomasida well-known kabi defis bilan yozilgan so‘z bitta so‘z sanaladi. Lekin asl imloda defissiz ikki so‘zni limitga sig‘dirish uchun sun’iy birlashtirmang. Har safar aynan topshiriqning so‘z va raqam chegarasini tekshiring.
answer.en: In standard Listening instructions, a genuinely hyphenated word such as well-known counts as one word. Do not invent hyphens to squeeze unrelated words into the limit. Check the particular word and number instruction.

questions.en: When should I include an article such as "a" or "the" in a gap completion answer?
questions.uz: Listening gap to‘ldirishda “a” yoki “the”ni javobga qo‘shish kerakmi?

answer.uz: Avval bo‘sh joydan oldin artikl allaqachon bormi, qarang. “a ___” uchun “a museum”ni yana to‘liq qo‘shish “a a museum” qiladi. Butun gapni javob bilan o‘qing, audio shakli, grammatika va word limitni birga tekshiring.
answer.en: Check whether the sentence already supplies the article. Adding “a museum” after “a ___” duplicates a. Read the completed sentence and verify the audio wording, grammar and word limit together.

questions.uz: Savolda o‘lchov birligi yozilgan bo‘lsa, Listening javobiga yana birlik yozamanmi?

answer.uz: Birlik savolda tashqarida berilgan bo‘lsa, ko‘pincha bo‘sh joyga faqat son kerak: “___ kg” → “15”. Javobni butun qatorga qo‘yib tekshiring; “15 kg kg” bo‘lib qolmasin. Alohida answer field yo‘riqnomasini ham o‘qing.
answer.en: If the unit is already supplied, the blank often needs only the number: “___ kg” → 15. Read the completed line to avoid “15 kg kg”, and follow any separate answer-field instructions.

answer.uz: Boshlanish nuqtasi va dastlabki qarash yo‘nalishini belgilang. Har burilishdan keyin hozirgi yurish yo‘nalishingizni yangilang: chap har doim qog‘ozning chap tomoni emas. Yo‘lni qisqa segmentlar bilan kuzating, mo‘ljal binolarda joyingizni tekshiring.
answer.en: Mark the start and initial facing direction. Update your orientation after every turn: left is relative to travel, not always the left side of the page. Trace short route segments and check landmarks.

questions.en: How can I separate a recommendation from a rejected suggestion in Listening?
questions.uz: Listeningda tavsiya qilingan fikrni rad etilgan taklifdan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Taklif va yakuniy tanlovni ajrating: “We could cycle, but it’s too far. Let’s take the bus.” Bu yerda cycle rad etilgan, bus tanlangan. “but”, sabab va keyingi kelishuvni birga eshiting; barcha tilga olingan variantlarni tavsiya deb olmang.
answer.en: Distinguish a suggestion from acceptance: “We could cycle, but it’s too far. Let’s take the bus.” Cycling is rejected; the bus is chosen. Follow the reason and agreement, not merely which options were mentioned.

answer.uz: Ustun sarlavhasi va qo‘shni kataklarni tekshiring: “Date” sana, “Cost” narx, “Material” narsa nomini kutadi. Keyin grammatika orqali birlik/ko‘plik yoki so‘z turkumini tekshiring. Bu javobni oldindan uydirish emas, qaysi ma’lumotni tinglashni belgilashdir.
answer.en: Use column headings and neighbouring cells to predict the information type: date, cost or material. Grammar can indicate singular/plural or part of speech. Predict the category to listen for, not an invented answer.

questions.uz: Listening flow-chartida strelkalar bo‘yicha qaysi tartibda javob yozaman?

answer.uz: Strelka jarayonning keyingi bosqichini ko‘rsatadi; qatorlarni faqat chapdan o‘ngga o‘qimang. Boshlanishni topib, har tugundan keyingi strelkani kuzating. “After”, “then”, “finally”ni bosqich mazmuni bilan birga tekshiring.
answer.en: Follow arrows from the starting stage rather than assuming ordinary reading order. Track each node and the next arrow. Link after, then and finally to what actually happens at that stage.

answer.uz: Har so‘zlovchiga qisqa alohida qayd oching. Bir kishi oldingi fikrini o‘zgartirsa, vaqt va savolda so‘ralgan pozitsiyani tekshiring. Variantni qayta ishlatish mumkinmi — yo‘riqnomadan biling; odam soni bilan fikrlar soni teng bo‘lishi shart emas.
answer.en: Keep separate notes for each speaker. If one changes opinion, check the time and position requested. Read whether an option may be reused; the number of speakers need not equal the number of views.

questions.en: How can I hear weak forms such as "of" and "to" in fast speech?
questions.uz: Tez nutqda “of” va “to” kabi kuchsiz shakllarni qanday eshitaman?

answer.uz: Of ko‘pincha /əv/, to /tə/ kabi kuchsizlashadi. Uch mashq: “a cup of tea”, “I want to go”, “a lot of work”. Avval transkript bilan tinglang, keyin matnni yopib bo‘lakni yozing; so‘z yo‘qolgan emas, urg‘usizlashgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
answer.en: Of may weaken to /əv/ and to to /tə/. Practise a cup of tea, I want to go and a lot of work. Listen with the transcript, hide it and transcribe the chunk; unstressed words may be reduced rather than absent.

questions.en: How do I recover when two answers pass while I am writing one?
questions.uz: Bitta javobni yozayotganimda yana ikkita javob o‘tib ketsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: O‘tgan javobga uzoq yopishib qolmang. Taxminiy belgi qo‘yib, navbatdagi savol tayanchiga ko‘zingizni qaytaring. Yozuvni qisqa tuting va keyin ruxsat etilgan tekshirish vaqtida imloni tuzating. Bitta bo‘sh javob sabab keyingi beshtasini yo‘qotmang.
answer.en: Mark the missed item and move to the next question cue instead of replaying it mentally. Use short notes and correct spelling during the permitted checking time. Avoid losing several later answers over one missed response.

questions.en: How do I locate the exact audio moment behind a wrong answer during review?
questions.uz: Listening tahlilida xato javob aytilgan audio joyini qanday topaman?

answer.uz: Savoldagi noyob ma’no yoki sinonimini transkriptdan toping, keyin oldingi va keyingi gapni o‘qing. Playerda shu joyni tinglab, qaysi so‘z javobni o‘zgartirganini belgilang. Men audio yoki timestamp berilmasa aniq sekundni uydirmayman.
answer.en: Locate the question’s idea or paraphrase in the transcript, read the surrounding sentences, then replay that section. Identify the decisive wording. Without the audio or timestamps, I cannot invent an exact second.

questions.en: How can I tell whether a Listening blank needs a singular or plural noun?
questions.uz: Listening bo‘sh joyiga birlik yoki ko‘plik ot kerakligini qanday bilaman?

answer.uz: Blank oldidagi a/an birlikni, many/several ko‘plikni kutishi mumkin; son va fe’l mosligini ham tekshiring. Misol: “three ___” → books. Oxirgi /s/ni audio bilan tekshiring: grammatik taxmin dalilning o‘rnini bosmaydi.
answer.en: An article may predict a singular noun; many, several or a number may predict plural. Check agreement and the audio ending: “three ___” suggests books. A grammatical prediction does not replace listening evidence.

questions.en: How do I distinguish "all" from "some" in True/False/Not Given?
questions.uz: TFNG savolida “all” va “some” so‘zlari hukmni qanday o‘zgartiradi?

answer.uz: “All” hammasini, “some” ayrimlarini bildiradi. “Some students cycle” butun guruh velosipedda yurishini isbotlamaydi va qolganlar yurmasligini ham o‘zi isbotlamaydi. Qarama-qarshi dalil bo‘lmasa “all” haqidagi da’vo Not Given bo‘lishi mumkin; matnning qolgan qismini tekshiring.
answer.en: All covers the whole group; some does not establish all, but alone does not prove that the rest do not. “Some students cycle” therefore may leave an all claim Not Given. Check the full passage for confirming or contradicting evidence.

questions.en: What if an author's claim is conditional in Yes/No/Not Given?
questions.uz: YNNGda muallif fikri “if” bilan cheklangan bo‘lsa, qanday baholayman?

answer.uz: “If X, Y” shartli fikr; uni shartsiz “Y doim bo‘ladi”ga aylantirmang. Muallif shartni zarur deb aytganmi yoki faqat bir holatni berganmi, tekshiring. Shart olib tashlangan gap avtomatik No emas: qarama-qarshilik bo‘lmasa Not Given bo‘lishi mumkin.
answer.en: “If X, Y” is conditional, not an unconditional Y. Check whether the author presents X as necessary or merely describes one case. Removing a condition is not automatically No; without contradiction, the claim may be Not Given.

questions.en: How can I tell the main heading from an interesting supporting detail?
questions.uz: Matching Headingsda asosiy g‘oyani qiziqarli detalldan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Paragrafga “Bu paragrafning butun maqsadi nima?” deb bir jumla yozing. Misol va qiziq sonlar shu fikrni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Heading faqat bitta detalga emas, paragrafning katta qismiga mos kelishi kerak. Qarama-qarshi burilishdan keyingi xulosani ham tekshiring.
answer.en: Summarise the purpose of the whole paragraph in one sentence. Examples and striking figures usually support that point. A heading must cover the paragraph rather than one detail; check any contrast and concluding shift.

questions.en: Why do Matching Information answers appear out of paragraph order?
questions.uz: Matching Informationda javoblar paragraf tartibida kelmasa, qanday qidiraman?

answer.uz: Matching Informationda dalillar savol tartibida kelishi shart emas. Har banddagi noyob fikrni belgilang, matndan tegishli joyni qidiring va paragraf harfini qayd qiling. Bir javob topilgani keyingisi faqat undan keyinda bo‘ladi degani emas.
answer.en: Matching Information need not follow paragraph order. Identify each item’s distinctive idea, scan for its evidence and note the paragraph letter. Finding one answer does not mean the next must appear later.

questions.en: Can the same person be used twice in Matching Features?
questions.uz: Matching Featuresda bitta odam ikki marta javob bo‘lishi mumkinmi?

answer.uz: Bitta ismni qayta ishlatish mumkinligi yo‘riqnomaga bog‘liq. “You may use any letter more than once” bo‘lsa mumkin. Har tavsifni odam bilan alohida dalil orqali bog‘lang; bir marta ishlatilgani uchun ismni avtomatik o‘chirmang.
answer.en: Read the instruction about reusing letters. If it permits reuse, the same person can match several statements. Find evidence for each association; do not eliminate a name merely because you have already used it.

questions.en: How do I eliminate a sentence ending that is grammatically possible but logically wrong?
questions.uz: Matching Sentence Endingsda grammatik to‘g‘ri, mazmunan xato yakunni qanday chiqaraman?

answer.uz: Avval gapni grammatik tugating, keyin yakundagi da’voni matn bilan tekshiring. Grammatik moslik nomzodni qoldiradi, ammo to‘g‘rilikni isbotlamaydi. Sabab-natija, vaqt va kimga tegishli ekanini solishtirib, dalilsiz yakunni chiqaring.
answer.en: Check grammar first, then test the completed claim against the passage. Grammatical fit makes an option possible, not correct. Verify cause, time and participants and eliminate endings lacking textual evidence.

questions.en: Why are there more headings than paragraphs?
questions.uz: Matching Headingsda paragrafdan ko‘p sarlavha bo‘lsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Ortiqcha headinglar chalg‘ituvchi variantlardir; hammasi ishlatilishi shart emas. Har paragrafning asosiy vazifasini qisqa yozib, mos headingni tanlang. Qolgan headingni majburan moslamang; cheklovchi so‘zlarini qayta tekshiring.
answer.en: Extra headings are distractors and need not all be used. Summarise each paragraph’s main function before matching. Do not force an unused heading onto a paragraph; recheck its qualifiers.

questions.en: How do I handle a flow-chart whose stages are described in different paragraphs?
questions.uz: Reading flow-chartidagi bosqichlar turli paragraflarda bo‘lsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Avval sxemadagi boshlanish va strelkalarni kuzating. Har bosqichning kalit ma’nosini matndan mustaqil toping; bosqichlar turli paragrafda tasvirlangan bo‘lishi mumkin. Birinchi dalil joylashuvi keyingi bosqich joyini kafolatlamaydi.
answer.en: Trace the flow-chart’s start and arrows, then locate evidence for each stage independently. Stages may be described in different paragraphs. The position of one answer does not guarantee where the next appears.

answer.en: With a word box, choose from the supplied options and follow whether letters are required. Without one, use passage words within the stated limit. In both cases, check the meaning and grammar of the completed summary.

questions.en: What does "NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER" allow?
questions.uz: “NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER” yo‘riqnomasida nimaga ruxsat berilgan?

answer.uz: “NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER” ikki so‘zgacha, bitta raqam yoki ularning ruxsat etilgan birikmasini bildiradi: “red books”, “15”, “15 red books”. Uch so‘z chegaradan oshadi. Javobning aynan shu blankka mos ma’nosini ham tekshiring.
answer.en: It allows up to two words, a number, or the permitted combination: red books, 15, or 15 red books. Three words exceed the word allowance. The answer must still match the particular blank and its meaning.

questions.en: Does a numeral count as a word in a Reading answer?
questions.uz: Reading javobidagi raqam so‘z chegarasiga qanday ta’sir qiladi?

answer.uz: Raqamning qabul qilinishi aynan yo‘riqnomaga bog‘liq. “AND/OR A NUMBER” bo‘lsa raqam uchun alohida ruxsat bor; “ONE WORD ONLY”ni xohlagan raqam bilan chetlab o‘tmang. Raqam bilan yozilgan va so‘z bilan yozilgan sonni bir xil sanash deb taxmin qilmang.
answer.en: Follow the precise instruction. AND/OR A NUMBER provides a number allowance; do not use a numeral to bypass an unrelated ONE WORD ONLY instruction. Do not assume a numeral and a number written in words are counted identically.

questions.en: How do I check punctuation and capitalisation in a Reading short answer?
questions.uz: Reading short answerda tinish belgisi va katta harf muhimmi?

answer.uz: Matndan kerakli so‘zni to‘g‘ri imlo bilan oling. Atoqli otning bosh harfi, defis va apostrofni tekshiring; ortiqcha tinish belgisi qo‘shmang. Saytdagi avtomatik tekshiruv qanday normallashtirishini bilmasdan “har qanday imlo qabul qilinadi” deb bo‘lmaydi.
answer.en: Copy the required wording with correct spelling. Check proper-name capitals, hyphens and apostrophes; avoid unnecessary punctuation. Do not assume the website accepts every spelling or punctuation variation without checking its feedback.

questions.en: Can a single paragraph answer several "Which paragraph" questions?
questions.uz: “Which paragraph” topshirig‘ida bitta paragraf bir necha savolga javob bo‘ladimi?

answer.uz: Bir paragraf bir nechta ma’lumotni berishi mumkin. Har savol uchun alohida dalil yozing va harfni qayta ishlatish yo‘riqnomasini o‘qing. Oldingi javobda ishlatilgan paragrafni avtomatik ro‘yxatdan chiqarish xato bo‘lishi mumkin.
answer.en: One paragraph can contain several requested facts. Find separate evidence for each and check the instruction on letter reuse. Automatically excluding an already used paragraph may produce an error.

questions.en: How can I avoid choosing a heading based only on the first sentence?
questions.uz: Headingni faqat birinchi gapga qarab tanlash xatosidan qanday qochaman?

answer.uz: Birinchi gap yo‘nalish beradi, ammo keyingi “however” fikrni burishi mumkin. Birinchi gap, burilish va yakuniy fikrni birga o‘qing. Headingni tanlashdan oldin paragrafning umumiy maqsadini o‘z so‘zingiz bilan ayting.
answer.en: The first sentence is a clue, but a later however may change the focus. Read the opening, contrast and final point together. State the paragraph’s overall purpose before choosing its heading.

questions.en: How can I recognise an unsupported inference in Reading?
questions.uz: Readingda matndan kelib chiqmaydigan taxminni qanday bilaman?

answer.uz: “Buni matndagi qaysi gap isbotlaydi?” deb so‘rang. Hayotda mantiqli tuyulgan xulosa matnda berilgan bo‘lishi shart emas. Sabab, niyat yoki universal qoida matnda bo‘lmasa ularni qo‘shmang; dalil yo‘qligi qarama-qarshilikning o‘zi emas.
answer.en: Ask which sentence proves the claim. A plausible real-world inference is not necessarily stated by the passage. Do not add an unstated cause, intention or universal rule; lack of evidence alone is not contradiction.

questions.en: How do double negatives affect a Reading statement?
questions.uz: Reading savolidagi ikki inkor ma’noni qanday o‘zgartiradi?

answer.uz: Inkor doirasini bosqichma-bosqich ajrating. “Not uncommon” — kamyob emas, ammo “always common” emas. “Not all failed” hech bo‘lmasa ayrimlari yiqilmaganini bildiradi; “none failed” bilan teng emas. So‘ng soddalashtirilgan ma’noni matn bilan solishtiring.
answer.en: Resolve the scope of each negative. Not uncommon is not the same as always common. Not all failed means at least some did not fail; it does not mean none failed. Compare the resulting meaning with the passage.

questions.en: How do I identify what "they" or "this" refers to in a passage?
questions.uz: Reading matnida “they” yoki “this” nimaga ishora qilganini qanday aniqlayman?

answer.uz: They uchun oldingi ko‘plik otlarni, this uchun oldingi fikr yoki hodisani tekshiring. Olmosh o‘rniga nomzod iborani qo‘yib gapni qayta o‘qing. Eng yaqin ot doim to‘g‘ri emas; son, ma’no va gaplar orasidagi bog‘lanish mos bo‘lishi kerak.
answer.en: Check earlier plural noun phrases for they and preceding ideas or events for this. Substitute a candidate reference and reread. The nearest noun is not always correct; number, meaning and discourse must fit.

questions.en: How do contrast markers such as "however" change the correct answer?
questions.uz: “However” va “nevertheless” Reading dalilini qanday o‘zgartiradi?

answer.uz: However oldingi kutishga zid keyingi fikrni kiritadi. “Cheap, however unreliable”da narx yaxshi, ishonchlilik yomon. Savol qaysi jihatni so‘rayotganini tekshiring va faqat burilishdan oldingi ijobiy so‘zga yopishib qolmang.
answer.en: However introduces a contrast with the preceding expectation. Cheap but unreliable gives a positive price and negative reliability. Check which dimension the question asks about rather than stopping at an earlier positive word.

queries: How can I separate correlation from causation in a Reading passage?

questions.en: How can I separate correlation from causation in a Reading passage?
questions.uz: Reading matnida bog‘liqlikni sabab-oqibatdan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Ikki narsa birga o‘zgargani biri boshqasiga sabab bo‘lganini isbotlamaydi. Matnda “associated with”mi yoki sababni tekshirgan tajribami, qarang. Uchinchi omil yoki teskari yo‘nalish ehtimoli bor; matndagi ehtiyotkor da’voni kuchaytirmang.
answer.en: Two variables changing together does not establish causation. Distinguish associated with from evidence designed to test a cause. A third factor or reverse direction may explain the link; preserve the passage’s level of certainty.

questions.en: How do I distinguish a researcher's hypothesis from a proven result?
questions.uz: Matnda tadqiqotchining taxmini bilan isbotlangan natijasini qanday farqlayman?

answer.uz: “May”, “hypothesised”, “suggested” taxminni; “results showed” tadqiqot natijasini ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Ammo bitta signal so‘zning o‘zi yetmaydi: kim aytgani, metod va cheklovni o‘qing. Natija ham har qanday sharoitda universal isbot degani emas.
answer.en: May, hypothesised and suggested can mark a hypothesis; results showed can report findings. Read the speaker, method and limitations rather than relying on one word. A finding is not automatically universal proof.

questions.en: What if the passage gives an example but the question asks for a rule?
questions.uz: Matnda misol berilgan, savolda umumiy qoida so‘ralsa, qanday javob beraman?

answer.uz: Bitta misol umumiy qoida uchun yetmasligi mumkin. “One school succeeded”dan “all schools succeed” chiqmaydi. Muallif misoldan qaysi chegaralangan fikrni ko‘rsatganini aniqlang; savoldagi guruh va chastota misoldan kengroqmi, tekshiring.
answer.en: One example may illustrate a point without proving a general rule. One school succeeded does not establish all schools succeed. Check whether the question broadens the group or frequency beyond the passage.

Trendlar kesishgan joyni qanday tushuntiraman?
Comparisonda qaysi davr ko‘rsatilganini qanday tekshiraman?

questions.en: How do I recognise a comparison that changes direction over time?
questions.uz: Readingda ikki ko‘rsatkichning ustunligi vaqt o‘tib almashsa, qanday tushunaman?

answer.uz: Vaqtni alohida ustunlarga ajrating: avval A>B, keyin A<B bo‘lishi mumkin. Savoldagi yil va “initially/later”ni belgilang. Hozirgi holatni oldingi davrga ko‘chirmang; kesishish yoki o‘zgarish qaysi vaqtda bo‘lganini tekshiring.
answer.en: Separate time periods: A may exceed B initially and fall below B later. Match the question’s date and qualifiers to the relevant period. Do not project a later relationship backwards.

queries: How do I use a heading's qualifier, such as "possible" or "only", to rule it out?

Sarlavhadagi cheklovchi so‘z xato javobga sabab bo‘ladimi?

questions.en: How do I use a heading's qualifier, such as "possible" or "only", to rule it out?
questions.uz: Headingdagi “possible” yoki “only” tanlovni qanday o‘zgartiradi?

answer.uz: Headingdagi possible ehtimolni, only yagona cheklovni bildiradi. Paragraf bir nechta sabab bersa “only cause” mos kelmaydi. Har headingning asosiy fikri bilan birga cheklovini ham tekshiring; mavzu bir xil bo‘lishining o‘zi yetmaydi.
answer.en: Possible expresses uncertainty; only excludes alternatives. A paragraph listing several causes cannot be summarised as the only cause. Check a heading’s qualifier as well as its subject.

Matndagi olim fikrini yozuvchi pozitsiyasi deb yuboryapman.
Quoted opinion muallifga tegishlimi?
YNNGda kimning qarashi so‘ralganini qanday bilaman?

questions.en: How do I avoid confusing a writer's opinion with a quoted person's opinion?
questions.uz: Readingda muallif fikrini iqtibos qilingan odam fikridan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Har fikr yoniga kimning ovozi ekanini yozing: muallif, tadqiqotchi yoki iqtibosdagi odam. Muallif boshqaning fikrini xolis keltirishi yoki rad etishi mumkin. Iqtibos borligi muallif shu qarashga qo‘shilganini bildirmaydi.
answer.en: Label each view with its source: writer, researcher or quoted person. The writer may report a view neutrally or reject it. Quotation alone does not establish the writer’s agreement.

Article vaqti tugadi, endi restart qilamanmi?

Reading article vaqt tugashida nima bo‘ladi?

questions.en: What should I do when the 20-minute article timer reaches zero?
questions.uz: Articlesdagi 20 daqiqalik taymer tugaganda qanday davom etaman?

answer.uz: Taymer nolga tushsa, sahifadagi yakunlangan yoki topshirilgan holatni tekshiring. Nol ko‘rinishi natija serverda saqlandi degan dalil emas. Avval mavjud javoblarni saqlang, keyin result yoki xato xabarini tekshiring; tasdiqsiz yangi urinish boshlamang.
answer.en: When the timer reaches zero, check the page’s submitted/completed status. Zero alone does not prove the server saved a result. Preserve answers and inspect the result or error before starting a replacement attempt.

questions.en: How can I resume an unfinished article without restarting it?
questions.uz: Tugallanmagan article’ni boshidan boshlamasdan qanday davom ettiraman?

answer.uz: Article ro‘yxatidan o‘sha matnni ochib, mavjud davom ettirish holatini tanlang. Restart yoki yangi urinishni bosishdan oldin oldingi javoblar va timer holatini tekshiring. Davom ettirish tugmasi bo‘lmasa, urinish nomi va ko‘rinadigan statusni yuboring; men sessiya tiklandi deb taxmin qilmayman.
answer.en: Open the same article and use its available resume state. Before selecting Restart or a new attempt, check the saved responses and timer. If no resume control appears, share the item and visible status; I cannot assume an attempt was restored.

questions.en: What does a vocabulary counter such as "10/12" mean in an article?
questions.uz: Article’dagi “10/12” vocabulary ko‘rsatkichi nimani anglatadi?

answer.uz: 10/12 kabi hisoblagich qaysi sarlavha yonida turganini tekshiring: u belgilangan so‘zlar yoki bajarilgan lug‘at vazifalari sonini bildirishi mumkin. Uni avtomatik 10 ta so‘z yodlandi deb talqin qilmang. Label yoki ekran ko‘rinishini bersangiz, aniq maydonni tushuntiraman.
answer.en: Read the counter’s label: 10/12 may describe selected vocabulary or completed vocabulary steps. It does not by itself prove ten mastered words. Share the adjacent label or screenshot so I can identify the exact counter.

Maqoladagi punktir so‘zni ikki marta bosish kerakmi?

Matndan dictionary popupni chiqarishni ko‘rsat.

questions.en: How do I open the dictionary popup on a highlighted article word?
questions.uz: Article matnida belgilangan so‘zning lug‘atini qanday ochaman?

answer.uz: Matndagi belgilangan so‘zni bosing yoki tanlang; lug‘at oynasi ochilsa kontekstga mos ma’no va so‘z turkumini tekshiring. Ochilmasa boshqa so‘zda sinang va tanlash rejimini tekshiring. Har qanday tagi chizilgan matn lug‘at tugmasi bo‘lishi shart emas.
answer.en: Tap or select the highlighted word and, if a dictionary panel opens, check the sense and part of speech for that sentence. If nothing opens, test another word and check selection mode. Not every underlined fragment is a dictionary control.

queries: How do I save every marked article word into one folder?

Add all vocabulary qanday ishlaydi?

questions.en: How do I save every marked article word into one folder?
questions.uz: Article’dagi barcha belgilangan so‘zlarni bir yo‘la papkaga qanday saqlayman?

answer.uz: Belgilangan so‘zlar ro‘yxatini ko‘rib, mavjud Save/Add boshqaruvida maqsad papkani tanlang. Har so‘zning to‘g‘ri ma’nosi tanlanganini tekshiring; keyin papkada saqlanganini tasdiqlang. Barchasini saqlash tugmasi ko‘rinmasa uni mavjud deb va’da qilmayman.
answer.en: Review the marked-word list and choose the destination folder in the available Save/Add control. Check each selected sense and verify the folder afterwards. I cannot promise a bulk-save control if none is shown.

queries: How can I use an existing vocabulary folder for article words?
Article so‘zlarini yangi papka ochmasdan mavjud papkamga qanday qo‘shaman?
Mavjud folderni tanlab so‘z saqlamoqchiman.
Article so‘zlarini eski papkaga joylash mumkinmi?
Save vocabulary paytida papkani qayerdan tanlayman?

questions.en: How can I use an existing vocabulary folder for article words?
questions.uz: Article so‘zlarini yangi papka ochmasdan mavjud papkamga qanday qo‘shaman?

answer.uz: Saqlash oynasida yangi papka ochish o‘rniga mavjud folderni tanlang, so‘ng saqlangan ro‘yxatni tekshiring. Bir xil yozilgan so‘zning boshqa ma’nosi alohida yozuv bo‘lishi mumkin. Nusxalarni o‘chirishdan oldin sense va so‘z turkumini solishtiring.
answer.en: Choose an existing folder in the save dialog and verify its contents afterwards. Identical spelling with a different sense may be a distinct item. Compare sense and part of speech before deleting apparent duplicates.

queries: Why is one article labelled B2 and another C1?

questions.en: Why is one article labelled B2 and another C1?
questions.uz: Articles ro‘yxatidagi B2 va C1 belgilari nimaga qarab qo‘yilgan?

answer.uz: B2/C1 yorlig‘i matnning belgilangan qiyinlik darajasidir; sizning umumiy darajangiz yoki rasmiy sertifikatingiz emas. Murakkablik lug‘at, gap tuzilishi va fikrning yashirinligiga bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin. Mos darajani mustaqil tushunish va xato tahlili bilan tanlang.
answer.en: B2/C1 labels describe assigned text difficulty, not your certified overall level. Vocabulary, syntax and implicit meaning can affect difficulty. Choose using your independent comprehension and error review, not the label alone.

queries: How can I compare my first and second attempts on the same article?

Article’ni ikki marta ishladim, qaysisida yaxshiroqman?
Oldingi attempt bilan keyingisini qayerda taqqoslayman?
Maqola bo‘yicha o‘sishni qanday bilaman?

questions.en: How can I compare my first and second attempts on the same article?
questions.uz: Bir article’ni qayta ishlaganimdagi natijani oldingisi bilan qanday solishtiraman?

answer.uz: Bir xil matnning urinish sanasi, aniqlik va sarflangan vaqtini solishtiring. Ikkinchi safar javobni eslab qolgan bo‘lishingiz mumkin; yaxshilanishni yangi matnda ham tekshiring. Oldingi urinish ko‘rinmasa, birinchi natijani o‘ylab topib solishtirmayman.
answer.en: Compare attempt dates, accuracy and time for the same article. A second attempt may benefit from remembering answers, so check transfer to a fresh text. If an earlier attempt is unavailable, I cannot invent a comparison.

Retentionni darhol matnga qaramay ishlash mumkinmi?

questions.en: What should I recall before reopening the passage in Retention?
questions.uz: Retentionda matnni qayta ochishdan oldin nimani xotiradan eslashim kerak?

answer.uz: Matnni qayta ochishdan oldin asosiy g‘oya, 2–3 dalil va ularning bog‘lanishini xotiradan ayting. Bilmagan joyga belgi qo‘ying, keyin ruxsat etilgan reviewda matn bilan solishtiring. Faol recall vaqtida matndan tayyor javob izlash eslab qolishni tekshirmaydi.
answer.en: Before reopening, recall the main idea, two or three supporting details and their relationships. Mark gaps, then compare during the permitted review. Looking up answers during active recall defeats the memory task.

queries: How do I learn from a Retention answer I remembered incorrectly?

Retention xatosini qanday tuzataman?
Xotira mashqidagi xato faktni qanday qayta tekshiraman?

questions.en: How do I learn from a Retention answer I remembered incorrectly?
questions.uz: Retentionda xato eslagan ma’lumotimni qanday qayta o‘rganaman?

answer.uz: Xotiradan aytgan fikringizni asl gap bilan solishtiring: qaysi raqam, sabab yoki ketma-ketlik o‘zgargan? To‘g‘ri shaklni o‘z so‘zingiz bilan qayta ayting, biroz tanaffusdan keyin yana eslang. Xatoni faqat o‘qib chiqish bilan cheklamang.
answer.en: Compare your recall with the original: which number, cause or sequence changed? Restate the corrected idea in your own words and retrieve it again after a delay. Merely rereading the correction is less informative than another recall attempt.

queries: How do I choose two key trends for a Task 1 overview?
Task 1 overview uchun eng muhim ikkita tendensiyani qanday tanlayman?
Grafikda ko‘p o‘zgarish bor, qaysilarini overviewga yozay?
Overviewdagi asosiy trendlarni saralashni o‘rgat.
Har bir raqamni keltirmasdan umumiy xulosani qanday yozaman?

questions.en: How do I choose two key trends for a Task 1 overview?
questions.uz: Task 1 overview uchun eng muhim ikkita tendensiyani qanday tanlayman?

answer.uz: Eng katta umumiy o‘zgarish va asosiy guruhlar orasidagi farqni tanlang. Overview barcha raqamlar ro‘yxati emas. Masalan, “Overall, car use rose, while bus use declined.” Ikkinchi fikr eng yuqori/past toifa yoki istisno bo‘lishi mumkin; grafikni ko‘rmasdan fakt qo‘shmayman.
answer.en: Choose the main overall change and a major comparison. An overview is not a list of figures. For example: Overall, car use rose, while bus use declined. A second feature might be the highest category or an exception; it must come from the actual chart.

queries: What should I do if a graph has no obvious overall increase or decrease?

Grafikda umumiy yo‘nalish yo‘q, xulosani qanday tuzaman?
Stable va fluctuating ma’lumotni overviewda qanday beraman?

questions.en: What should I do if a graph has no obvious overall increase or decrease?
questions.uz: Grafikda aniq o‘sish yoki pasayish bo‘lmasa, overviewga nima yozaman?

answer.uz: Ko‘tarilish yoki pasayish bo‘lmasa ham asosiy xususiyat bor: barqarorlik, tebranish, eng katta guruh yoki guruhlar farqi. “Overall, the figures fluctuated within a narrow range.” kabi gapni faqat grafik mos kelsa ishlating; yo‘q trendni yaratmang.
answer.en: Look for stability, fluctuation, the dominant category or a major comparison rather than inventing growth. “Overall, the figures fluctuated within a narrow range” works only when the chart supports it.

queries: How do I distinguish percentage change from percentage-point change?

20% dan 30% ga chiqsa 10% o‘sishmi?

Grafikdagi foizlarni noto‘g‘ri taqqoslamaslikni tushuntir.

questions.en: How do I distinguish percentage change from percentage-point change?
questions.uz: Writing Task 1’da foiz o‘zgarishi bilan foiz punktini qanday farqlayman?

answer.uz: 20%dan 30%ga — 10 percentage points o‘sish. Nisbiy o‘sish esa (30−20)/20×100 = 50%. “10 percent” bilan “10 percentage points”ni almashtirmang. Avval boshlang‘ich qiymat va o‘lchov birligini yozing, keyin farqni hisoblang.
answer.en: From 20% to 30% is an increase of 10 percentage points. The relative increase is (30−20)/20×100 = 50%. Keep the starting value and unit visible so percent and percentage points do not get confused.

queries: How do I describe a trend from 2000 to 2010 without mixing up "by" and "to"?
2000–2010 oralig‘idagi trendda “by” va “to”ni qanday ishlataman?
Increased by va increased to farqi nima?
Miqdor qanchaga o‘sganini qanday yozaman?
Task 1da “to 50” va “by 50”ni adashtirmaslik usuli qanday?

questions.en: How do I describe a trend from 2000 to 2010 without mixing up "by" and "to"?
questions.uz: 2000–2010 oralig‘idagi trendda “by” va “to”ni qanday ishlataman?

answer.uz: To yakuniy qiymatni, by o‘zgarish miqdorini beradi. “Sales rose to 80” — oxiri 80. “Sales rose by 20” — 20 qo‘shildi. “Sales rose from 60 to 80” — boshlanish va yakun. Yillar uchun “from 2000 to 2010” yoziladi.
answer.en: To introduces the final value; by introduces the amount of change. Sales rose to 80. Sales rose by 20. Sales rose from 60 to 80. Use from 2000 to 2010 for the time span.

queries: How should I use tenses when a bar chart has no time axis?

questions.en: How should I use tenses when a bar chart has no time axis?
questions.uz: Vaqt ko‘rsatilmagan bar chartni qaysi zamonda tasvirlayman?

answer.uz: Vaqt ko‘rsatilmagan diagrammada umumiy taqqoslash uchun present simple odatda mos: “Group A has the largest share.” Agar sarlavha yoki matnda o‘tgan yil berilsa, past simple kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. Faqat x o‘qiga emas, barcha vaqt ma’lumotiga qarang.
answer.en: For a timeless comparison, present simple is often appropriate: Group A has the largest share. A past date in the title or caption may instead require past simple. Check every time reference, not just the axis.

queries: How can I compare two charts that use different measurement units?
Bir Task 1’da ikkita grafik turli birlikda bo‘lsa, qanday taqqoslayman?
Biri foiz, biri million bilan berilgan.
Different unitsni bitta overviewda aralashtirsam bo‘ladimi?
Mixed data bilan qanday ehtiyotkor comparison yozaman?

questions.en: How can I compare two charts that use different measurement units?
questions.uz: Bir Task 1’da ikkita grafik turli birlikda bo‘lsa, qanday taqqoslayman?

answer.uz: Turli birliklarni bevosita tenglashtirmang: tonna va foiz alohida o‘lchov. Har bir grafikning birligi bilan trendini tushuntiring; bog‘lanish bo‘lsa ehtiyotkor taqqoslang. Foizni miqdorga aylantirish uchun umumiy son kerak; berilmasa uni taxmin qilmang.
answer.en: Do not directly equate different units such as tonnes and percentages. Describe each chart using its own units and compare supported patterns. Converting a percentage to an amount requires a known total; do not invent one.

queries: How do I describe features that remained unchanged on a map?
Task 1 mapda o‘zgarmagan joylarni qanday tasvirlayman?
Xaritadagi ayrim binolar o‘sha holicha qolgan.
Unchanged features uchun qanday iboralar ishlatiladi?
Ikki xaritadagi bir xil elementlarni ham yozish kerakmi?

questions.en: How do I describe features that remained unchanged on a map?
questions.uz: Task 1 mapda o‘zgarmagan joylarni qanday tasvirlayman?

answer.uz: O‘zgarmagan joyni aniq nomlang: “The bridge remained in the same location.” O‘zgarish bilan taqqoslang: “The road was widened, but the park was unchanged.” Uchinchisi: “The school retained its original position.” Xarita ko‘rsatmagan sababni qo‘shmang.
answer.en: Name unchanged features explicitly: The bridge remained in the same location. The road was widened, but the park was unchanged. The school retained its original position. Do not add a reason absent from the map.

queries: How do I write an overview for a cyclical process with no clear beginning?
Boshlanishi yo‘q aylana process diagram uchun overview qanday yoziladi?
Cycle jarayonida first stepni topolmayapman.
Takrorlanadigan jarayonni umumiy qilib qanday ifodalayman?
Cyclical processni linear processdan qanday ajrataman?

questions.en: How do I write an overview for a cyclical process with no clear beginning?
questions.uz: Boshlanishi yo‘q aylana process diagram uchun overview qanday yoziladi?

answer.uz: Siklik jarayonda sun’iy boshlanish yoki tugash yaratmang. Overviewda aylanish va asosiy bosqichlarni ayting: “Overall, the process is cyclical, with water returning to its initial state.” Tafsilotda tushuntirish uchun qulay bosqichdan boshlab doirani to‘liq kuzating.
answer.en: State that the process is cyclical and identify its main phases. Choose a convenient stage for explaining the details without claiming it is the only beginning. Follow the complete cycle and its return to an earlier state.

queries: When should I use the passive voice in a process diagram?
Process diagramda passive voice qachon ishlatiladi?
Kim bajargani ko‘rsatilmagan jarayonni qanday yozaman?
The material is heated kabi gaplarni qanday tuzaman?
Task 1 jarayonida active yoki passive qaysi biri mos?

questions.en: When should I use the passive voice in a process diagram?
questions.uz: Process diagramda passive voice qachon ishlatiladi?

answer.uz: Ishni bajaruvchi muhim yoki noma’lum bo‘lsa passive foydali: “The beans are dried.” Tabiiy jarayonda active mos: “Water evaporates.” Uchinchi misol: “The mixture is heated.” Jarayon va zamonga qarab shaklni tanlang; har gapni passive qilish shart emas.
answer.en: Use passive when the operation matters more than an unknown or unimportant agent: The beans are dried. Natural processes often use active: Water evaporates. The mixture is heated is another passive example; not every process sentence needs passive voice.

queries: How can I compare values shown in thousands and millions without an error?
Ming va million birliklari aralashgan grafikni qanday taqqoslayman?
Thousandsni millionsga noto‘g‘ri aylantiryapman.
Grafikdagi son birliklarini qanday tekshiraman?
Task 1’da 0.5 million va 500 thousand tengmi?

questions.en: How can I compare values shown in thousands and millions without an error?
questions.uz: Ming va million birliklari aralashgan grafikni qanday taqqoslayman?

answer.uz: Avval ikkala qiymatni bir birlikka o‘tkazing: 1 million = 1,000 thousand. 2.5 million va 900 thousandni 2.5 bilan 900 deb taqqoslamang; 2,500,000 va 900,000 deb tekshiring. Yakuniy gapda birlikni aniq yozing.
answer.en: Convert to a shared unit first: one million equals one thousand thousand. Compare 2.5 million with 900 thousand as 2,500,000 versus 900,000, not 2.5 versus 900. State the unit clearly in the final sentence.

queries: How do I avoid listing every number in a Task 1 body paragraph?
Task 1 bodyda barcha raqamlarni sanab chiqmaslik uchun nima qilaman?
Grafikni data dump qilib yozib qo‘yyapman.
Faqat muhim raqamlarni qanday tanlayman?
Taqqoslashni ko‘paytirib, ortiqcha sonlarni qanday qisqartiraman?

questions.en: How do I avoid listing every number in a Task 1 body paragraph?
questions.uz: Task 1 bodyda barcha raqamlarni sanab chiqmaslik uchun nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Raqamlarni o‘xshash trend yoki kattalik bo‘yicha guruhlang. Har paragrafda bir taqqoslashni ochib, unga 2–3 muhim qiymatni dalil qiling. Barcha nuqtani sanash o‘rniga eng katta, eng kichik va muhim o‘zgarishni tanlang.
answer.en: Group figures by shared trend or magnitude. Develop a comparison in each paragraph and support it with a few important values. Select meaningful extremes and changes rather than listing every data point.

queries: What does "to what extent do you agree or disagree" require in Task 2?
Task 2’dagi “to what extent do you agree or disagree” nimani talab qiladi?
Qisman rozi bo‘lsam yozish mumkinmi?
Extent degan joyda pozitsiyani qanday ko‘rsataman?
Bu essay savolida aniq stance qayerda bo‘lishi kerak?

questions.en: What does "to what extent do you agree or disagree" require in Task 2?
questions.uz: Task 2’dagi “to what extent do you agree or disagree” nimani talab qiladi?

answer.uz: “To what extent” — qay darajada rozi yoki qarshi ekaningizni aniq ko‘rsating va shu pozitsiyani asoslang. To‘liq yoki qisman rozi bo‘lish mumkin, lekin sabablar pozitsiyaga mos bo‘lsin. Kirishdagi fikr bilan xulosa bir yo‘nalishda qolishi kerak.
answer.en: State how far you agree or disagree and justify that position. Full or qualified agreement is possible, but your reasons must support it. Keep the introduction, body and conclusion consistent.

queries: How do I cover both views and my opinion without losing focus?
“Discuss both views and give your opinion” esseysida uchala talabni qanday qamrayman?
Ikki fikrni yozdim, o‘z qarashimga joy qolmadi.
Discussion essayda opinion qaysi paragrafda bo‘lishi kerak?
Both views va personal viewni qanday muvozanatlashtiraman?

questions.en: How do I cover both views and my opinion without losing focus?
questions.uz: “Discuss both views and give your opinion” esseysida uchala talabni qanday qamrayman?

answer.uz: Savolning uch vazifasini ajrating: birinchi qarash, ikkinchi qarash va o‘z fikringiz. Har qarashni adolatli sabab bilan tushuntiring, keyin qaysi tomon nega kuchliroq ekanini belgilang. Fikrni faqat oxirgi bir gapga yashirib qo‘ymang.
answer.en: Identify all three duties: explain one view, explain the other, and give your opinion. Develop each fairly and show why your judgement follows. Do not leave your stance as an unsupported final sentence.

queries: How do I distinguish causes from problems in a causes-and-solutions essay?
Causes and solutions esseysida sababni muammoning o‘zidan qanday ajrataman?
Problemni yozib, cause yozmay qo‘yyapman.
Cause va consequence o‘rtasidagi farq nima?
Essay savolida aynan sabab so‘ralganini qanday bilaman?

questions.en: How do I distinguish causes from problems in a causes-and-solutions essay?
questions.uz: Causes and solutions esseysida sababni muammoning o‘zidan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Cause — muammoni paydo qilgan omil; problem — uning zararli holati yoki oqibati; solution — sabab yoki zararni kamaytiradigan choradir. Masalan, kam transport — sabab, tirbandlik — muammo, jamoat transportini yaxshilash — yechim. Aynan savol so‘ragan ikki qismga javob bering.
answer.en: A cause produces the issue; a problem is the harmful condition or consequence; a solution addresses it. Limited transport can be a cause, congestion the problem, and improved public transport a response. Answer the categories actually requested.

queries: How can I make a clear judgement in an "outweigh" essay?
“Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” savolida hukmni qanday aniq beraman?
Afzalliklar ko‘p deb yozishning o‘zi yetadimi?
Outweigh essayda qaysi tomon ustunligini qanday isbotlayman?
Disadvantagesdan ko‘proq degan pozitsiyani qanday yoritaman?

questions.en: How can I make a clear judgement in an "outweigh" essay?
questions.uz: “Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?” savolida hukmni qanday aniq beraman?

answer.uz: “Outweigh” afzallik va kamchilikni sanashdan ko‘ra ularning ahamiyatini solishtirishni talab qiladi. Qaysi tomon kuchliroq va nima uchunligini yozing: ta’sir hajmi, davomiylik yoki kimga ta’sir qiladi. Uchta mayda foyda bitta katta zarardan avtomatik ustun emas.
answer.en: Outweigh requires a judgement about importance, not just a count of advantages and disadvantages. Compare scale, duration or who is affected. Three minor benefits do not automatically outweigh one substantial harm.

queries: How do I find both tasks hidden inside a two-part essay question?
Two-part essay savolida ikkita mustaqil talabni qanday ajrataman?
Savolning ikkinchi qismini unutib yuboryapman.
Double-question taskni qanday rejalashtiraman?
Task 2da ikkala savolga javob berilganini qanday tekshiraman?

questions.en: How do I find both tasks hidden inside a two-part essay question?
questions.uz: Two-part essay savolida ikkita mustaqil talabni qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Savoldagi ikkita so‘roq yoki buyruqni alohida yozing. Har biriga tezis va dalil rejalang; biri “why”, ikkinchisi “what can be done” bo‘lsa, ikkinchisiga yana sabab yozmang. Yakunda ikkala savolga aniq javob berilganini tekshiring.
answer.en: Write out both tasks separately and plan a direct answer and support for each. If one asks why and the other asks what can be done, do not answer both with causes. Check that neither task was omitted.

queries: How do I check whether my example truly supports the topic sentence?
Body paragraphdagi misolim topic sentence’ni isbotlayaptimi, qanday tekshiraman?
Misolim mavzudan chiqib ketganini qanday bilaman?
Topic sentence va example orasidagi mantiqiy aloqani tushuntir.
Misol faqat qiziqarli emas, dalil bo‘lishi uchun nima kerak?

questions.en: How do I check whether my example truly supports the topic sentence?
questions.uz: Body paragraphdagi misolim topic sentence’ni isbotlayaptimi, qanday tekshiraman?

answer.uz: Misoldan keyin “Bu qaysi sababni qanday ko‘rsatadi?” deb bir gap yozing. Bog‘lanishni tushuntira olmasangiz misol mavzudan chetda bo‘lishi mumkin. Topic sentence ta’lim xarajati haqida bo‘lsa, umumiy texnologiya qulayligi bunga o‘zi dalil emas.
answer.en: After the example, explain exactly how it supports the paragraph’s claim. If that connection is missing, the example may be irrelevant. A general convenience of technology does not by itself support a claim about education costs.

queries: Is it acceptable to invent precise statistics in IELTS Writing Task 2?
Writing Task 2’da aniq statistik raqamlarni o‘ylab topsam bo‘ladimi?
Essayga “87% people” degan uydirma ma’lumot qo‘shsam nima bo‘ladi?
Real manbasiz son yozish foydalimi?
Task 2da misol keltirish uchun statistik ma’lumot shartmi?

questions.en: Is it acceptable to invent precise statistics in IELTS Writing Task 2?
questions.uz: Writing Task 2’da aniq statistik raqamlarni o‘ylab topsam bo‘ladimi?

answer.uz: Aniq foiz, tadqiqot yoki tashkilot nomini o‘ylab topmang. Fikringizni mantiqiy sabab va aniq, tasavvuriy deb tushunarli vaziyat bilan rivojlantiring. “For example, a student with a part-time job may…” kabi misol tekshirilmagan “87% of students”dan yaxshiroq.
answer.en: Do not fabricate precise statistics, studies or organisations. Develop a logical explanation and a clearly illustrative situation. “For example, a student with a part-time job may…” is preferable to an invented claim about 87% of students.

queries: How do I use a concession without contradicting my thesis?
Essayda qarshi fikrni tan olib, tezisimga zid bo‘lmaslikni qanday ta’minlayman?
Although I accept... deb boshlasam fikrim susayadimi?
Concessiondan keyin refutation qanday keladi?
Qarshi tomon kuchli bo‘lsa ham pozitsiyamni qanday saqlayman?

questions.en: How do I use a concession without contradicting my thesis?
questions.uz: Essayda qarshi fikrni tan olib, tezisimga zid bo‘lmaslikni qanday ta’minlayman?

answer.uz: Concession qarshi tomonning cheklangan kuchli jihatini tan oladi, tezisingizni bekor qilmaydi. “Although buses require investment, their long-term benefits justify the cost.” Keyin nega asosiy pozitsiya saqlanishini tushuntiring; butun qarama-qarshi fikrni tasdiqlab yubormang.
answer.en: A concession recognises a limited opposing point while retaining your thesis: Although buses require investment, their long-term benefits justify the cost. Explain why the main judgement still stands rather than endorsing the entire opposite position.

queries: Why is a pronoun such as "this" sometimes unclear in Writing?
Writingda “this” so‘zi nimaga ishora qilgani noaniq bo‘lsa, qanday tuzataman?
This leads to deb yozsam nima ekanligi bilinmayapti.
Unclear reference xatosini qanday topsam bo‘ladi?
This issue yoki this trend deb aniq yozish kerakmi?

questions.en: Why is a pronoun such as "this" sometimes unclear in Writing?
questions.uz: Writingda “this” so‘zi nimaga ishora qilgani noaniq bo‘lsa, qanday tuzataman?

answer.uz: This bir nechta oldingi fikrga ishora qilsa noaniq bo‘ladi. Aniqlashtiruvchi ot qo‘shing: “this increase”, “this policy”, “this delay”. So‘ng aynan qaysi hodisani nazarda tutganingizni tekshiring; faqat so‘zni almashtirish mantiqiy bog‘lanishni tuzatmasligi mumkin.
answer.en: This becomes unclear when several preceding ideas could be its reference. Add a precise noun: this increase, this policy, this delay. Check the intended referent; replacing a pronoun alone may not repair the logic.

queries: How can I avoid overusing connectors such as "moreover" and "therefore"?
Essayda “moreover” va “therefore”ni ortiqcha ishlatmaslik uchun nima qilaman?
Har gapni linking word bilan boshlayapman.
Connectorsni tabiiy ishlatishni o‘rgat.
Bog‘lovchilar ko‘pligi cohesionni pasaytiradimi?

questions.en: How can I avoid overusing connectors such as "moreover" and "therefore"?
questions.uz: Essayda “moreover” va “therefore”ni ortiqcha ishlatmaslik uchun nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Connectorni gaplar orasidagi haqiqiy munosabatga qarab tanlang. Moreover qo‘shimcha, therefore natijani bildiradi. Har gap boshiga bog‘lovchi qo‘shish o‘rniga olmosh, sinonim va mavzu davomiyligidan foydalaning. Sabab bo‘lmasa therefore yozmang.
answer.en: Choose a connector for the actual relationship: moreover adds information; therefore marks a result. Use clear reference and topic continuity instead of attaching a connector to every sentence. Do not signal a consequence without a cause.

queries: How do I turn a broad argument into a specific Task 2 claim?
Task 2’da umumiy fikrimni aniq dalilga aylantirishni qanday o‘rganaman?
“Education is important” juda umumiy fikrmi?
Broad idea uchun bitta konkret claim tuzib ber.
Essaydagi dalilim noaniq bo‘lsa qanday toraytiraman?

questions.en: How do I turn a broad argument into a specific Task 2 claim?
questions.uz: Task 2’da umumiy fikrimni aniq dalilga aylantirishni qanday o‘rganaman?

answer.uz: Keng fikrni kim, qaysi sharoit va qanday mexanizm bilan toraytiring. “Technology is good” o‘rniga “Recorded lessons help working students review missed explanations.” Keyin nima uchun va qaysi cheklovda foyda berishini tushuntiring.
answer.en: Specify who benefits, under what conditions and through what mechanism. Replace Technology is good with Recorded lessons help working students review missed explanations. Then explain the benefit and its limits.

queries: Should one body paragraph contain one reason or several related reasons?
Task 2 body paragraphida bitta sababmi yoki bir nechta bog‘liq sabab yozaman?
Bir paragrafda ikkita argument aralashtirib yubordim.
Body paragraph unity nima bilan belgilanadi?
Bitta asosiy fikrni necha misol bilan rivojlantirish mumkin?

questions.en: Should one body paragraph contain one reason or several related reasons?
questions.uz: Task 2 body paragraphida bitta sababmi yoki bir nechta bog‘liq sabab yozaman?

answer.uz: Bir paragrafda bitta markaziy fikr bo‘lsin; unga xizmat qiladigan yaqin sabablar bo‘lishi mumkin. Har sababni tushuntirmay ro‘yxat qilishdan saqlaning. Agar ikkinchi sabab boshqa tezisga o‘tib ketsa, alohida paragraf oching.
answer.en: Use one central point per paragraph, with closely related reasons if they support it. Develop the reasoning instead of listing undeveloped ideas. Start another paragraph when a new reason changes the main focus.

queries: How can I avoid weakening my stance in the conclusion?
Task 2 xulosasida pozitsiyamni sustlashtirib yubormaslik uchun nima qilaman?
Introductionda roziman dedim, conclusionda ikkilanib qoldim.
Conclusionda stance izchil bo‘lishi kerakmi?
Essay yakunida fikrimni qanday qisqa va aniq takrorlayman?

questions.en: How can I avoid weakening my stance in the conclusion?
questions.uz: Task 2 xulosasida pozitsiyamni sustlashtirib yubormaslik uchun nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Xulosada kirishdagi pozitsiyani aniqroq, qisqa qaytaring va asosiy sababni jamlang. Yangi qarama-qarshi fikr yoki yangi dalil kiritmang. “May be good or bad” kabi noaniq yakun aniq tezisni zaiflashtirishi mumkin.
answer.en: Restate the same judgement concisely and synthesise its main support. Avoid a new argument or opposing stance. An uncertain ending such as may be good or bad can weaken an otherwise clear thesis.

queries: How do I decide whether a sentence is too long for accurate Writing?
Writingda gap haddan tashqari uzunligini qanday aniqlayman?
Murakkab gap yozaman deb grammatikani buzib qo‘yyapman.
Uzun gapni ikkiga bo‘lish qachon yaxshiroq?
Accuracy uchun gapni soddalashtirish mezoni qanday?

questions.en: How do I decide whether a sentence is too long for accurate Writing?
questions.uz: Writingda gap haddan tashqari uzunligini qanday aniqlayman?

answer.uz: Gap uzunligini so‘z soni emas, uni xatosiz boshqarishingiz belgilaydi. Har bir fe’lning egasi, bog‘lovchi va olmosh ishorasini tekshiring. Ikki mustaqil fikr faqat vergul bilan ulangan bo‘lsa, nuqta yoki mos bog‘lovchi qo‘ying. Aniqlik murakkablikdan ustun.
answer.en: Judge a sentence by control, not length alone. Check subjects, verb agreement, connectors and references. If two independent clauses are joined only by a comma, use proper punctuation or a conjunction. Prioritise clarity over complexity.

questions.en: What happens during the five-second preview in Speak or Die?
questions.uz: Speak or Die’dagi 5 soniyalik tayyorlanish vaqtida nima qilishim kerak?

answer.uz: Speak or Die’dagi qisqa previewda mavzuni o‘qing va uch tayanchni tanlang: javob, sabab, misol. Bu vaqtni to‘liq matn yodlashga sarflamang. Taymer va recording holatini ekrandan tekshiring; preview tugashi bilan gapirishga tayyor bo‘ling.
answer.en: During the short Speak or Die preview, identify three cues: answer, reason and example. Do not try to memorise a script. Check the displayed timer and recording state, then be ready to speak.

queries: How can I keep speaking for 60 seconds without memorising a script?

60-second speaking uchun sodda struktura ber.
Speak or Die’da gapim 20 soniyada tugab qoladi, nima qilay?

questions.en: How can I keep speaking for 60 seconds without memorising a script?
questions.uz: Speak or Die’da 60 soniya davomida yodlangan matnsiz qanday gapiraman?

answer.uz: 60 soniyani tayyor skriptsiz to‘ldirish uchun javob → sabab → aniq voqea → qisqa xulosa tartibini ishlating. 3–4 kalit so‘z yetarli. Bir fikrni qayta aytish o‘rniga qachon, kim bilan va nega degan tafsilot qo‘shing.
answer.en: Use answer, reason, specific experience and brief conclusion. Prepare a few cues rather than a script. Extend with when, who and why instead of repeating the same sentence until sixty seconds pass.

queries: What should I do if I finish my Speak or Die answer too early?

Bir savolga davom ettirib gapirish usulini ko‘rsat.

questions.en: What should I do if I finish my Speak or Die answer too early?
questions.uz: Speak or Die’da javobim vaqt tugamasdan bitib qolsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Javob erta tugasa, mazmunli misol yoki taqqoslash qo‘shing: qachon bo‘ldi, natijasi nima, hozir nimasi boshqacha? Savoldan chetga chiqib sun’iy gapni cho‘zmang. Keyingi urinishda uch tayanchli reja bilan vaqtni mashq qiling.
answer.en: Add a relevant example, comparison or consequence if you finish early. Explain when it happened, what resulted or what changed. Do not pad with unrelated talk; practise timing with a three-cue plan next time.

questions.en: How can I get ready for an unexpected Speak or Die topic?
questions.uz: Speak or Die’da kutilmagan mavzu chiqsa, fikrni qanday tez yig‘aman?

answer.uz: Kutilmagan mavzuda mukammal g‘oya izlamang. Savol turini taning, oddiy haqiqiy misol tanlang, sabab va tafsilot bilan kengaytiring. Bilmagan faktni uydirmang; shaxsiy tajriba yoki ehtiyotkor umumiy misol bilan javob bering.
answer.en: Identify the question type, choose a simple familiar example and expand with a reason and detail. Do not invent facts to sound impressive. Use your experience or a clearly hypothetical illustration.

questions.en: What should I say if I completely forget a word while recording?
questions.uz: Ovoz yozayotganda kerakli inglizcha so‘z esdan chiqsa, qanday davom etaman?

answer.uz: So‘zni unutib qolsangiz, vazifasi yoki ko‘rinishini ayting: “It’s a tool for opening bottles.” Yoki sodda sinonim ishlating va davom eting. Uzoq sukutdan ko‘ra qisqa qayta ifodalash foydali; aniq nomni keyingi tahlilda lug‘atdan tekshiring.
answer.en: Describe the function or appearance: It’s a tool for opening bottles. Use a simpler synonym and continue. A short paraphrase is more useful than a long silence; look up the exact word during review.

queries: How can I tell if the microphone has been enabled for AI speaking?

questions.en: How can I tell if the microphone has been enabled for AI speaking?
questions.uz: AI Speaking’da mikrofon ruxsati berilganini qanday tekshiraman?

answer.uz: Brauzerning mikrofon ruxsati bilan sahifadagi yozuv indikatori alohida narsalar. Ruxsatni tekshiring, so‘ng recording holati va ovoz belgisi o‘zgarayotganini ko‘ring. RIWI dictation faqat qurilmada matnga aylantiradi; Speaking yozuvi esa boshqa modulning jarayoni.
answer.en: Browser microphone permission and an active recording are separate. Check permission, then the page’s recording indicator. RIWI dictation produces editable text on-device; a Speaking recording follows that module’s separate workflow.

questions.en: What can I do when AI speaking repeats the same question?
questions.uz: AI Speaking bir xil savolni qayta bersa, nima qilishim kerak?

answer.uz: Savol qaytarilsa, recording/submission qabul qilinganmi va keyingi bosqichga o‘tilganmi, tekshiring. Bir xil savolni yangi bosqich deb taxmin qilmang. Sahifa nomi, savol va ko‘rinadigan status bilan xabar bering; takror bosishdan oldin javobni saqlang.
answer.en: Check whether your response was accepted and the next stage actually started. A repeated question is not proof of progress. Report the page, question and visible status, preserving your response before repeated retries.

queries: What should I check if a recording finishes but no speaking feedback appears?

questions.en: What should I check if a recording finishes but no speaking feedback appears?
questions.uz: Ovoz yozuvi tugab, Speaking feedback chiqmasa, nimalarni tekshiraman?

answer.uz: Yozuv tugashi, serverga topshirish va feedback tayyor bo‘lishi uch alohida holat. Avval audio preview, keyin submitted status, keyin baholash/xato xabarini tekshiring. Qayta yuborishdan oldin mavjud yozuvni saqlang; ko‘rinmagan bahoni tayyor deb aytmayman.
answer.en: Recording completion, submission and feedback availability are distinct. Check the audio preview, submitted status and any grading/error message in that order. Preserve the recording before retrying; absent feedback cannot be treated as a completed score.

queries: How do I tell a microphone problem from a speaking-scoring problem?
Speaking’da mikrofon muammosini baholash muammosidan qanday ajrataman?

questions.en: How do I tell a microphone problem from a speaking-scoring problem?
questions.uz: Speaking’da mikrofon muammosini baholash muammosidan qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Playbackda ovoz yo‘q yoki qurilma ruxsati rad etilgan bo‘lsa capture muammosini tekshiring. Audio eshitilib, submitted bo‘lsa-yu feedback chiqmasa, topshirish/baholash holatini tekshiring. Ikkalasini bir xato deb olmang; ko‘rinadigan xabar sababni toraytiradi.
answer.en: Silent playback or denied permission suggests a capture problem. Audible, submitted audio without feedback requires checking submission or grading state. These are different failure points; the visible error helps distinguish them.

queries: How can I listen to my recorded answer and find repeated fillers?

Speakingda ortiqcha fillerlarni kamaytirish mashqini ber.

questions.en: How can I listen to my recorded answer and find repeated fillers?
questions.uz: O‘z Speaking yozuvimni tinglab “um” va “you know” takrorlarini qanday topaman?

answer.uz: Yozuvni bir marta mazmun, ikkinchi marta takroriy filler uchun tinglang. “Um”, “like”, “you know” ishlatilgan joylarni qisqa qayd qiling; hammasini taqiqlash shart emas. Keraksiz takror o‘rniga qisqa tabiiy pauza bilan shu javobni yana ayting.
answer.en: Listen once for meaning and again for repeated fillers. Note unnecessary um, like or you know, rather than banning every natural discourse marker. Repeat the answer using brief pauses where habitual filler adds nothing.

questions.en: Why might I appear offline until I open the partner-finding page?
questions.uz: Sherik topish sahifasiga kirmaganimda nega offline ko‘rinishim mumkin?

answer.uz: Partner sahifasidagi mavjudlik holati joriy ulanish va presence yangilanishiga bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin. Oddiy profil ochiqligi faol call kutayotganingizni isbotlamaydi. Find Partner sahifasini ochib holatni tekshiring; boshqalarning ko‘rinishini doimiy onlayn dalil deb olmang.
answer.en: Partner availability may depend on the page’s current connection and presence updates. Having a profile does not prove you are waiting for a call. Check Find Partner and its status; an old online indicator is not permanent evidence.

queries: How do I change the level filter without changing my profile level?

questions.en: How do I change the level filter without changing my profile level?
questions.uz: Sherik qidirishda level filtrini profil darajamni o‘zgartirmasdan qanday almashtiraman?

answer.uz: Qidiruvdagi level filter faqat ko‘rinadigan nomzodlarni saralaydi; profil darajasini tahrirlash boshqa amal. Filtrni o‘zgartirib ro‘yxatni tekshiring, profilga o‘zgartirish kiritilgan deb hisoblamang. O‘zingizga mos suhbatdoshni mashq maqsadi bilan tanlang.
answer.en: A search-level filter changes the candidate list; editing your profile level is a separate action. Change the filter and inspect the results without assuming your profile changed. Choose a partner suited to your practice goal.

questions.en: What do the male, female and everyone filters do in partner search?
questions.uz: Speaking partner qidiruvidagi male, female va everyone filtrlari nimani bildiradi?

answer.uz: Male/Female/Everyone qidiruv ro‘yxatini tanlangan mezon bo‘yicha filtrlashga xizmat qiladi. Bu foydalanuvchining huquqi yoki til darajasini o‘zgartirmaydi. Natija bo‘lmasa Everyone bilan tekshirish mumkin; ko‘rinmagan odamning shaxsiy ma’lumotini taxmin qilmang.
answer.en: Male, Female and Everyone filter the partner list. They do not change account permissions or language level. If no matches appear, try Everyone; do not infer private facts about users who are not shown.

queries: What should I do after sending a call invitation to a partner?

questions.en: What should I do after sending a call invitation to a partner?
questions.uz: Sherikka qo‘ng‘iroq taklifini yuborgach, keyingi qadam nima?

answer.uz: Taklif yuborgach, qabul qilingan yoki rad etilgan holatni kuting; yuborildi degani call boshlandi emas. Qabul qilinsa mikrofon va ulanish holatini tekshiring. Bir odamga ketma-ket takliflar yuborish o‘rniga ko‘rinadigan holatga qarang.
answer.en: Wait for an accepted or declined invitation state. Sent does not mean the call has started. After acceptance, check the microphone and connection; avoid repeatedly inviting the same person while an invitation is pending.

questions.en: How do I decline an incoming speaking call without blocking the person?
questions.uz: Kelgan Speaking qo‘ng‘irog‘ini foydalanuvchini bloklamasdan qanday rad etaman?

answer.uz: Kiruvchi taklifdagi Decline/Rad etish faqat shu taklifni rad etadi; Block alohida cheklovdir. Shunchaki hozir gaplasha olmasangiz Decline’ni tanlang. Tugma nomini o‘qing, tasdiqlash bo‘lsa qaysi amal so‘ralganini tekshiring.
answer.en: Decline rejects the current invitation; Block is a separate restriction. Use Decline if you simply cannot talk now. Read the control and any confirmation so you do not unintentionally choose a stronger action.

questions.en: What should I do if a partner call disconnects unexpectedly?
questions.uz: Sherik bilan suhbat kutilmaganda uzilib qolsa, qanday tiklayman?

answer.uz: Avval tarmoq, qurilma ruxsati va sahifadagi call holatini tekshiring. Qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilishdan oldin eski call tugaganini tasdiqlang. Muammo takrorlansa vaqt, qurilma va xato xabarini Supportga bering; boshqaning aloqa ma’lumotini chatga kiritmang.
answer.en: Check network, device permission and the call state. Confirm that the old call ended before starting another. If disconnections recur, report the time, device and error without sharing the partner’s private contact details.

questions.en: How are peer IELTS-style ratings different from an examiner score?
questions.uz: Sherik bergan 0–9 baho haqiqiy examiner bahosidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

answer.uz: Partner bergan IELTS-style baho tengdosh fikridir; rasmiy imtihonchi bahosi yoki sertifikat emas. Uni fluency, vocabulary, grammar va pronunciation bo‘yicha amaliy maslahat sifatida ko‘ring. Bitta call natijasidan umumiy bandni kafolatlab bo‘lmaydi.
answer.en: A partner’s IELTS-style rating is peer feedback, not an official examiner score or certificate. Use it as practice feedback on fluency, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation. One call cannot guarantee your overall band.

questions.en: When should the partner-rating window appear after a call?
questions.uz: Speaking call tugagach sherikni baholash oynasi qachon chiqishi kerak?

answer.uz: Rating oynasi callning yakunlangan holati va modulning shartlariga bog‘liq. Oyna chiqmasa, call tugaganmi va sahifada review amali bormi, tekshiring. Men ko‘rinmagan oynani ochildi deb aytmayman; aniq call holatini yozing.
answer.en: The rating prompt depends on the call reaching the appropriate ended state and the module’s conditions. If it is absent, check whether the call ended and a review control is available. Share the visible state rather than assuming a prompt appeared.

Peer ratings average qanday tushuniladi?

questions.en: How does an average of partner ratings differ from a single call rating?
questions.uz: Partnerdan olingan o‘rtacha baho bitta suhbatdagi bahodan qanday farq qiladi?

answer.uz: Bitta rating — bir suhbat haqidagi fikr; average — bir nechta ruxsatli ratingning yig‘ma ko‘rsatkichi. O‘rtachani tushunishda nechta baho va qaysi mezon ekanini tekshiring. Kichik namuna yoki yumaloqlash bir call bilan farq chiqarishi mumkin.
answer.en: One rating concerns one call; an average aggregates available ratings. Check the number of ratings and the criterion. A small sample or rounding may explain why the average differs from one recent call.

queries: How can I report misconduct after a speaking partner call?

questions.en: How can I report misconduct after a speaking partner call?
questions.uz: Speaking sherigi noo‘rin harakat qilsa, suhbatdan keyin qanday xabar beraman?

answer.uz: Nomaqbul muomalani Report/Support orqali aniq vaqt va hodisa tavsifi bilan bildiring. Zarur bo‘lsa callni tugating va mavjud Block amalidan foydalaning. Shaxsiy ma’lumotni ommaviy tarqatmang; RIWI chatga shikoyat yozishning o‘zi report yuborilganini anglatmaydi.
answer.en: Use Report or Support with the time and a factual description. End the call and use the available Block control if needed. Avoid publicly sharing private details; describing it to RIWI alone does not submit a formal report.

queries: What is the difference between "used to" and "be used to"?
“Used to” bilan “be used to” o‘rtasidagi farq nima?
