Used to bilan be used toga alohida misollar ber.

questions.en: What is the difference between "used to" and "be used to"?
questions.uz: “Used to” bilan “be used to” o‘rtasidagi farq nima?

answer.uz: Used to + asosiy fe’l — avvalgi odat yoki holat. Be used to + ot/-ing — ko‘nikkanlik. Get used to — ko‘nikib borish. Uch misol: “I used to cycle.” — Avval velosiped minardim. “I am used to cycling.” — Bunga ko‘nikkanman. “I’m getting used to cycling.” — Ko‘nikib boryapman.
answer.en: Used to + base verb describes a past habit/state. Be used to + noun/-ing means accustomed to; get used to means become accustomed. Examples: I used to cycle. I am used to cycling. I’m getting used to cycling.

queries: When does "hardly...when" require inverted word order?
“Hardly...when” konstruktsiyasida qachon inversion ishlatiladi?
Hardly had I... when tuzilishini tushuntir.
Hardly bilan gapni qanday boshlasam bo‘ladi?
Hardly...when zamon va so‘z tartibini ko‘rsat.

questions.en: When does "hardly...when" require inverted word order?
questions.uz: “Hardly...when” konstruktsiyasida qachon inversion ishlatiladi?

answer.uz: Hardly gap boshida vaqt ma’nosida kelsa yordamchi fe’l egadan oldinga chiqadi: Hardly had + ega + V3 + when. “Hardly had I arrived when it rained.” “Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang.” “I had hardly arrived when it rained.” Oxirgisida hardly boshda emas, inversion yo‘q.
answer.en: Fronted temporal hardly triggers auxiliary–subject inversion, commonly Hardly had + subject + past participle + when. Examples: Hardly had I arrived when it rained. Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang. I had hardly arrived when it rained has no fronted inversion.

queries: How do "if only" and "only if" differ?
“If only” va “only if” nimasi bilan farqlanadi?
If only afsusmi, only if shartmi?
Ikki iboraning o‘rnini almashtirsam ma’no o‘zgaradimi?
If only va only if uchun qisqa misollar ber.

questions.en: How do "if only" and "only if" differ?
questions.uz: “If only” va “only if” nimasi bilan farqlanadi?

answer.uz: If only — kuchli istak yoki afsus; only if — qat’iy shart. “If only I knew!” — Qani bilsam! “You can leave only if you finish.” — Faqat tugatsangiz ketasiz. “Only if you finish can you leave.” — Shart boshga chiqsa bosh gapda inversion bo‘ladi.
answer.en: If only expresses a strong wish/regret; only if sets a condition. Examples: If only I knew! You can leave only if you finish. Only if you finish can you leave. Fronting only if causes inversion in the main clause, not inside the if-clause.

queries: How do I use "wish" for a present regret versus a past regret?
“Wish” bilan hozirgi va o‘tmishdagi afsusni qanday ifodalayman?
I wish I knew va I wish I had known farqi nima?
Hozirgi armon va kechagi pushaymonni wishda ajrat.
Wishdan keyin past simple yoki past perfect qachon keladi?

questions.en: How do I use "wish" for a present regret versus a past regret?
questions.uz: “Wish” bilan hozirgi va o‘tmishdagi afsusni qanday ifodalayman?

answer.uz: Hozirgi afsus uchun wish + past form, o‘tmishdagi afsus uchun wish + had + V3. “I wish I knew.” — Hozir bilmayman. “I wish I had studied.” — O‘shanda o‘qimaganimdan afsusdaman. “I wish I could swim.” — Suzishni bilsam edi. Past form bu yerda doim o‘tgan vaqt degani emas.
answer.en: Use wish + past form for an unreal present and wish + past perfect for past regret. Examples: I wish I knew. I wish I had studied. I wish I could swim. The past form in the first example marks remoteness rather than past time.

queries: Why do we say "I'd rather you went" rather than "you go"?
Nega “I'd rather you went” deyiladi, “you go” emas?
Would ratherdan keyin boshqa odamga past tense ishlatiladimi?
I'd rather you didn't gapini qanday tuzaman?
Rather orqali boshqa kishiga istak bildirish qoidasi nima?

questions.en: Why do we say "I'd rather you went" rather than "you go"?
questions.uz: Nega “I'd rather you went” deyiladi, “you go” emas?

answer.uz: Would ratherdan keyin boshqa ega kelsa hozirgi/kelajak istagi past form bilan beriladi. Bir xil egada base verb ishlatiladi. “I’d rather you went now.” — Siz hozir ketsangiz ma’qul. “I’d rather stay.” — Qolganim ma’qul. “I’d rather you had called.” — O‘shanda qo‘ng‘iroq qilganingiz ma’qul edi.
answer.en: With a different subject, would rather uses a past form for a present/future preference. With the same subject, use the base verb. Examples: I’d rather you went now. I’d rather stay. I’d rather you had called expresses a past preference/regret.

queries: How does the causative "have something done" work?
“Have something done” causative konstruktsiyasi qanday ishlaydi?

Biror ishni boshqaga qildirishni inglizcha qanday aytaman?
Have/get something done gaplarini tushuntir.

questions.en: How does the causative "have something done" work?
questions.uz: “Have something done” causative konstruktsiyasi qanday ishlaydi?

answer.uz: Have + narsa + V3 ishni boshqasiga bajartirishni bildiradi; zamon have orqali o‘zgaradi. “I had my hair cut.” — Sochimni oldirdim. “She is having her car repaired.” — Mashinasini tuzattiryapti. “We’ll have the windows cleaned.” — Derazalarni tozalattiramiz. Kontekstda boshdan kechirilgan hodisani ham bildirishi mumkin.
answer.en: Have + object + past participle often means arranging for someone to do something. Tense is carried by have. Examples: I had my hair cut. She is having her car repaired. We’ll have the windows cleaned. Context can also give an experience/affected-person meaning.

queries: How do "make someone do" and "get someone to do" differ?
“Make someone do” va “get someone to do” farqi nima?
Majburlash va ko‘ndirish fe’llari qanday tuziladi?
Make me do bilan get me to do bir xilmi?
Causative verbsning object va infinitive qoidasi qanday?

questions.en: How do "make someone do" and "get someone to do" differ?
questions.uz: “Make someone do” va “get someone to do” farqi nima?

answer.uz: Make + object + base verb majburlash/sabab bo‘lish; get + object + to-infinitive ko‘ndirish/tashkil etish bo‘lishi mumkin. “They made me wait.” — Kuttirishdi. “I got him to help.” — Yordamga ko‘ndirdim. “I was made to wait.” — Passive make’da to qaytadi.
answer.en: Make takes object + base verb; get takes object + to-infinitive, often with persuasion/arrangement. Examples: They made me wait. I got him to help. I was made to wait. Passive make restores to.

queries: How can I shorten a relative clause to a participle phrase?
Relative clause’ni participle phrase’ga qanday qisqartiraman?
The man who is standing ni qanday qisqartirsa bo‘ladi?
Reduced relative clause qoidasi nima?
Who/which tushiriladigan holatlarni misol bilan ko‘rsat.

questions.en: How can I shorten a relative clause to a participle phrase?
questions.uz: Relative clause’ni participle phrase’ga qanday qisqartiraman?

answer.uz: Aniqlanayotgan ot ishtirokchi bo‘lsa active -ing yoki passive V3 qisqartirish mumkin. “Students who live here” → “Students living here”. “Books that were written in 2000” → “Books written in 2000”. “The man who called”ni har qanday zamonda “the man calling” qilish mumkin emas: vaqt va ma’no saqlanishi kerak.
answer.en: A relative clause may reduce to an active -ing or passive participle when the meaning fits. Examples: students who live here → students living here; books that were written in 2000 → books written in 2000. The man who called cannot always become the man calling without changing time/meaning.

queries: Why must a participle clause refer to the correct subject?
Participle clause’da harakat bajaruvchisi bir xil bo‘lishi nega muhim?
Walking home, the rain started xato gapmi?
Dangling participle nima ekanini tushuntir.
-ing bilan boshlangan gapda subject qayerda bo‘lishi kerak?

questions.en: Why must a participle clause refer to the correct subject?
questions.uz: Participle clause’da harakat bajaruvchisi bir xil bo‘lishi nega muhim?

answer.uz: Kirishdagi participle harakati bosh gap egasiga tegishli bo‘lsin. “Walking home, I saw a dog.” — Men yurdim. “While I was walking home, it started raining.” — Yomg‘ir yurgani yo‘q. “Having finished the work, she left.” — U tugatdi va ketdi. Ega mos bo‘lmasa to‘liq clause yozing.
answer.en: The understood subject of an introductory participle normally matches the main-clause subject. Examples: Walking home, I saw a dog. While I was walking home, it started raining. Having finished the work, she left. Use a full clause to avoid a dangling modifier.

queries: When should I use "having finished" instead of "finishing"?
“Having finished” bilan “finishing”ning vaqt farqi nima?
Perfect participle qachon ishlatiladi?
Ish oldin tugaganini -ing clause’da qanday bildiraman?
Having done va doingni misol bilan solishtir.

questions.en: When should I use "having finished" instead of "finishing"?
questions.uz: “Having finished” bilan “finishing”ning vaqt farqi nima?

answer.uz: Having + V3 bir ish boshqasidan oldin tugaganini aniq ko‘rsatadi. “Having finished dinner, we left.” — Ovqat tugagach ketdik. “Finishing dinner, we discussed the trip.” — Tugatayotib gaplashdik. “Having been warned, he stayed away.” — Ogohlantirilgach yaqinlashmadi. -ingning o‘zi ham kontekstda oldingi ishni bildirishi mumkin.
answer.en: Having + past participle explicitly marks prior completion. Examples: Having finished dinner, we left. Finishing dinner, we discussed the trip. Having been warned, he stayed away. A simple -ing clause can also describe an earlier action when context makes the sequence clear.

queries: How does inversion work after "not only" at the beginning of a sentence?
Gap boshida “not only” kelganda inversion qanday ishlaydi?
Not only did he... tuzilishini tushuntir.

Not only bilan boshlanadigan gapga misollar ber.

questions.en: How does inversion work after "not only" at the beginning of a sentence?
questions.uz: Gap boshida “not only” kelganda inversion qanday ishlaydi?

answer.uz: Not only gap boshida kelib clause’ni cheklasa yordamchi fe’l egadan oldinga chiqadi. “Not only did she study, but she also worked.” “Not only is it cheap, but it is also reliable.” “She not only studies but also works.” Oxirgisida inversion yo‘q.
answer.en: Fronted clause-level not only triggers inversion. Examples: Not only did she study, but she also worked. Not only is it cheap, but it is also reliable. She not only studies but also works does not require inversion.

queries: Which verb agrees with "neither...nor" subjects?
“Neither...nor” bilan fe’l qaysi egaga moslashadi?

Ikki ega neither/nor bilan kelsa verbni qanday tanlayman?
Nearest subject agreementni tushuntir.

questions.en: Which verb agrees with "neither...nor" subjects?
questions.uz: “Neither...nor” bilan fe’l qaysi egaga moslashadi?

answer.uz: Neither…nor bilan ikki birlik ega odatda birlik fe’l oladi. Aralash sonli egada yaqin ega bilan moslik keng ishlatiladi; noqulay gapni qayta tuzing. “Neither Ali nor Vali is here.” “Neither the teacher nor the students are ready.” “Neither the students nor the teacher is ready.”
answer.en: Two singular subjects normally take a singular verb. With mixed number, agreement commonly follows the nearer subject; rephrase awkward cases. Examples: Neither Ali nor Vali is here. Neither the teacher nor the students are ready. Neither the students nor the teacher is ready.

queries: How do "little" and "few" change meaning with or without "a"?

questions.en: How do "little" and "few" change meaning with or without "a"?
questions.uz: “Little/few” va “a little/a few” orasida qanday ma’no farqi bor?

answer.uz: Few/a few sanaladigan ko‘plik otlar, little/a little sanalmaydigan otlar bilan. A bo‘lmasa yetarli emas degan salbiy ohang kuchliroq. “Few students came.” — Juda kam. “A few students came.” — Bir nechtasi. “We have a little time.” — Oz bo‘lsa-da vaqt bor.
answer.en: Few/a few modify plural count nouns; little/a little modify uncount nouns. Without a, the meaning is more negative. Examples: Few students came. A few students came. We have a little time. Compare insufficient quantity with some available quantity.

queries: When do I use "fewer" instead of "less"?

Fewer/less qoidasidagi o‘lchov istisnolari qanday?

questions.en: When do I use "fewer" instead of "less"?
questions.uz: “Fewer” va “less”ni qaysi otlar bilan ishlataman?

answer.uz: Fewer sanaladigan ko‘plik, less odatda sanalmaydigan miqdor bilan. “Fewer cars arrived.” “We used less water.” “The trip took less than two hours.” Vaqt, pul va masofa kabi bitta o‘lchov deb qaralgan ifodalarda less ishlatilishi mumkin.
answer.en: Use fewer for plural count nouns and less for uncount quantity. Examples: Fewer cars arrived. We used less water. The trip took less than two hours. Less is also common for amounts of time, money and distance treated as a measure.

queries: Why does "each of the students" take a singular verb?
“Each of the students”dan keyin nega birlik fe’l keladi?

Each va everydan keyin verbni qanday tanlayman?
Each of plural noun konstruktsiyasini tushuntir.

questions.en: Why does "each of the students" take a singular verb?
questions.uz: “Each of the students”dan keyin nega birlik fe’l keladi?

answer.uz: Each alohida bittalab qaraydi; “of the students” ko‘plik bo‘lsa ham asosiy ega each. “Each of the students is ready.” “Each of us has a task.” “The students are ready.” Oxirgi gapda ega students, shuning uchun are.
answer.en: Each is the singular head; of the students does not turn it into a plural subject. Examples: Each of the students is ready. Each of us has a task. The students are ready has a plural head and takes are.

queries: Can "none of" take both singular and plural verbs?
“None of”dan keyin birlik ham, ko‘plik ham fe’l kelishi mumkinmi?
None of them is va are qaysi biri to‘g‘ri?
None of bilan agreementni qanday tanlayman?
None of qaysi holatda singular ishlatiladi?

questions.en: Can "none of" take both singular and plural verbs?
questions.uz: “None of”dan keyin birlik ham, ko‘plik ham fe’l kelishi mumkinmi?

answer.uz: None of bilan fe’l ma’no va otga bog‘liq. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan birlik: “None of the water is clean.” Ko‘plik ot bilan plural ham, rasmiyroq singular ham uchraydi: “None of the students are ready.” “None of the students is ready.” Kontekst va uslubni saqlang.
answer.en: Agreement depends on the noun and intended meaning. Examples: None of the water is clean. None of the students are ready. None of the students is ready. Plural agreement is common with plural count nouns; singular is also used, especially for a not-one interpretation.

queries: How do "the number of" and "a number of" affect verb agreement?
“The number of” va “a number of” bilan fe’l qanday o‘zgaradi?
The number of students is, a number are nega?
Number of iboralari singular/plural qoidasi nima?
Bu ikki birikmani gapda to‘g‘ri ishlatishni ko‘rsat.

questions.en: How do "the number of" and "a number of" affect verb agreement?
questions.uz: “The number of” va “a number of” bilan fe’l qanday o‘zgaradi?

answer.uz: The number of — sonning o‘zi, birlik; a number of — bir qancha, ko‘plik. “The number of students is rising.” — Talabalar soni oshmoqda. “A number of students are absent.” — Bir nechtasi yo‘q. “The number has doubled.” — Son ikki baravar bo‘ldi.
answer.en: The number of has a singular head referring to a total; a number of means several and takes plural agreement. Examples: The number of students is rising. A number of students are absent. The number has doubled.

queries: Why can "as if" be followed by a past form for an unreal situation?
“As if”dan keyin haqiqiy bo‘lmagan vaziyat uchun past form nega keladi?
He acts as if he knew degani nima?
As if va as thoughni qanday ishlataman?
As if unreal meaningda qaysi zamon ishlatiladi?

questions.en: Why can "as if" be followed by a past form for an unreal situation?
questions.uz: “As if”dan keyin haqiqiy bo‘lmagan vaziyat uchun past form nega keladi?

answer.uz: As if + past form hozirgi vaziyatdan uzoq, go‘yoki haqiqiy emas degan ma’noni bera oladi. “He talks as if he knew everything.” “She looks as if she is tired.” “He acted as if he had seen a ghost.” Ikkinchisida holat haqiqatan bo‘lishi mumkin, uchinchisida oldingi hodisa.
answer.en: A past form after as if can mark an unreal present comparison. Examples: He talks as if he knew everything. She looks as if she is tired suggests a plausible current state. He acted as if he had seen a ghost refers to an earlier event.

queries: What is the difference between "so...that" and "such...that"?
“So...that” bilan “such...that”ning grammatik farqi nima?
So beautiful va such a beautiful day farqi nima?
So va suchdan keyin qaysi so‘z turkumi keladi?
Result clause uchun so/suchni qaysi holatda tanlayman?

questions.en: What is the difference between "so...that" and "such...that"?
questions.uz: “So...that” bilan “such...that”ning grammatik farqi nima?

answer.uz: So + adjective/adverb + that; such + noun phrase + that. “It was so cold that we stayed in.” “It was such a cold day that we stayed in.” “She spoke so quietly that I couldn’t hear.” Such a/an faqat birlik sanaladigan ot birikmasida keladi.
answer.en: Use so + adjective/adverb + that, but such + noun phrase + that. Examples: It was so cold that we stayed in. It was such a cold day that we stayed in. She spoke so quietly that I couldn’t hear. Use a/an only with an appropriate singular count noun.

queries: How do "too...to" and "enough...to" differ?
“Too...to” va “enough...to” qanday farqlanadi?
Too tired to go va old enough to go nima degani?
Too va enoughning joylashuvi qanday?
Harakatga yetarli yoki ortiqcha darajani qanday ifodalayman?

questions.en: How do "too...to" and "enough...to" differ?
questions.uz: “Too...to” va “enough...to” qanday farqlanadi?

answer.uz: Too — kerakdan ortiq, natijani to‘sishi mumkin; enough — yetarli. “It is too heavy to lift.” — Ko‘tarishga og‘irlik qiladi. “It is light enough to carry.” — Ko‘tarish uchun yetarlicha yengil. “We have enough time to finish.” Enough sifatdan keyin, otdan oldin.
answer.en: Too expresses excess; enough expresses sufficiency. Examples: It is too heavy to lift. It is light enough to carry. We have enough time to finish. Enough follows an adjective but precedes a noun.

queries: Can "unless" always replace "if...not"?
“Unless” har doim “if...not”ning o‘rnini bosa oladimi?
Unless bilan if not bir xil ma’nodami?
Unless ishlatilmaydigan kontekst bormi?
Shart gapda unlessni xatosiz tanlashni tushuntir.

questions.en: Can "unless" always replace "if...not"?
questions.uz: “Unless” har doim “if...not”ning o‘rnini bosa oladimi?

answer.uz: Unless ko‘pincha “except if / agar…bo‘lmasa” degani, lekin har bir if not gapini mexanik almashtirmang. “Unless it rains, we’ll walk.” “If it doesn’t rain, we’ll walk.” “I’ll be surprised if he doesn’t come.” Oxirgisini unless bilan almashtirish ma’noni o‘zgartiradi.
answer.en: Unless often means except if, but cannot mechanically replace every if not. Compare: Unless it rains, we’ll walk. If it doesn’t rain, we’ll walk. I’ll be surprised if he doesn’t come does not preserve its meaning with a simple unless substitution.

queries: How do "provided that" and "as long as" express conditions?
“Provided that” va “as long as” shartni qanday ifodalaydi?
Provided that rasmiyroqmi?
As long as qachon vaqt emas, shart bildiradi?
Bu conditional bog‘lovchilarni misollar bilan tushuntir.

questions.en: How do "provided that" and "as long as" express conditions?
questions.uz: “Provided that” va “as long as” shartni qanday ifodalaydi?

answer.uz: Provided that va as long as shartni bildiradi: faqat shu shart bajarilsa. “You can borrow it provided that you return it.” “You may stay as long as you are quiet.” “I’ll help as long as I have time.” As long as boshqa kontekstda davomiylikni ham bildirishi mumkin.
answer.en: Provided that and conditional as long as introduce a condition. Examples: You can borrow it provided that you return it. You may stay as long as you are quiet. I’ll help as long as I have time. As long as can also express duration in another context.

queries: How do I form a passive sentence in the third conditional?
Third conditionalda passive voice qanday tuziladi?
It would have been repaired if... gapini izohla.
Would have been plus V3 qayerda ishlatiladi?
O‘tmishdagi shartni passiv shaklda qanday aytaman?

questions.en: How do I form a passive sentence in the third conditional?
questions.uz: Third conditionalda passive voice qanday tuziladi?

answer.uz: Third conditional passive shakllari: if + had been + V3; would have been + V3. “If it had been repaired, it would have worked.” “If we had left it outside, it would have been damaged.” “If it had been checked, the error would have been found.” O‘tgan real bo‘lmagan natijani ko‘rsatasiz.
answer.en: Use had been + past participle in a passive if-clause and would have been + past participle for a passive result. Examples: If it had been repaired, it would have worked. If we had left it outside, it would have been damaged. If it had been checked, the error would have been found.

queries: How do "must have" and "could have" express different past deductions?
O‘tmish haqida “must have” va “could have” qanday farqli taxmin bildiradi?
He must have left bilan he could have left farqi nima?
O‘tgan voqea taxminida ishonch darajasi qanday beriladi?
Past deduction modal verbsni solishtir.

questions.en: How do "must have" and "could have" express different past deductions?
questions.uz: O‘tmish haqida “must have” va “could have” qanday farqli taxmin bildiradi?

answer.uz: Must have + V3 — o‘tmish haqida kuchli xulosa; could have + V3 — mumkin bo‘lgan hodisa yoki ishlatilmagan imkoniyat. “She must have left.” “She could have taken a taxi.” “You could have called me.” Qaysi ma’no ekanini kontekst belgilaydi; could have doim sodir bo‘lmagan degani emas.
answer.en: Must have marks a strong past deduction; could have may express past possibility or an unused opportunity. Examples: She must have left. She could have taken a taxi. You could have called me. Could have does not always imply that the event did not happen.

queries: What is the difference between "needn't have done" and "didn't need to do"?
“Needn't have done” va “didn't need to do” o‘rtasidagi farq nima?
Keraksiz bo‘lsa ham qildim degan ma’no qaysisida?
Needn't have gone bilan didn't need to go farqi nima?
Bu ikkita perfect modalni o‘zbekcha izohla.

questions.en: What is the difference between "needn't have done" and "didn't need to do"?
questions.uz: “Needn't have done” va “didn't need to do” o‘rtasidagi farq nima?

answer.uz: Needn’t have done — ish bajarilgan, ammo kerak bo‘lmagan. Didn’t need to do — zarurat bo‘lmagan; ish bajarilgan-bajarilmagani kontekstdan bilinadi. “You needn’t have bought bread.” “I didn’t need to work, so I rested.” “I didn’t need to cook, but I did.” Oxirgi gapni imkonsiz deb olmang.
answer.en: Needn’t have done means it happened but was unnecessary. Didn’t need to do states absence of necessity; context tells whether it happened. Examples: You needn’t have bought bread. I didn’t need to work, so I rested. I didn’t need to cook, but I did.

queries: How does "should have" differ between criticism and expectation?
“Should have” qachon tanqid, qachon kutilgan natijani bildiradi?
You should have called deganda tanbeh bormi?
The train should have arrived degani nima?
Should have + V3ning ikki vazifasini ko‘rsat.

questions.en: How does "should have" differ between criticism and expectation?
questions.uz: “Should have” qachon tanqid, qachon kutilgan natijani bildiradi?

answer.uz: Should have + V3 tanqid/afsus yoki kutishni bildiradi. “You should have called.” — Qo‘ng‘iroq qilishingiz kerak edi. “The train should have arrived by now.” — Hozirgacha kelgan bo‘lishi kerak. “I should have checked.” — Tekshirmaganimdan afsus. Qaysi ma’no ekanini vaziyatdan tanlang.
answer.en: Should have can express criticism/regret or expectation. Examples: You should have called. The train should have arrived by now. I should have checked. Context distinguishes an unmet obligation from an expected past event.

queries: Why does an indirect question use statement word order?
Indirect questionda nega odatiy gapdagi so‘z tartibi ishlatiladi?
Can you tell me where he is, where is he emasmi?
Bilvosita savolda inversion bo‘lmaydimi?
Could you tell me bilan savol tuzishni o‘rgat.

questions.en: Why does an indirect question use statement word order?
questions.uz: Indirect questionda nega odatiy gapdagi so‘z tartibi ishlatiladi?

answer.uz: Bilvosita savolda ichki clause darak tartibida: ega + fe’l. “Where is he?” → “Do you know where he is?” “What does she need?” → “Tell me what she needs.” “Is it open?” → “I wonder if it is open.” Ichki gapda savol uchun qo‘shilgan do/does qolmaydi.
answer.en: An embedded question uses statement order. Examples: Where is he? → Do you know where he is? What does she need? → Tell me what she needs. Is it open? → I wonder if it is open. Remove question-only do-support inside the embedded clause.

queries: How do I embed a question inside a noun clause?
Noun clause ichiga savolni qanday joylashtiraman?
I don't know what he wants gapini tushuntir.
What he said bilan what did he say farqi nima?
Embedded question va direct question tartibini solishtir.

questions.en: How do I embed a question inside a noun clause?
questions.uz: Noun clause ichiga savolni qanday joylashtiraman?

answer.uz: Wh-savolda wh-so‘z, keyin ega + fe’l; yes/no savolda if/whether + ega + fe’l ishlating. “I know where she lives.” “Tell me whether you agree.” “What he said surprised me.” Uchinchi misolda butun wh-clause bosh gapning egasi.
answer.en: Use a wh-word followed by subject + verb, or if/whether for a yes/no question. Examples: I know where she lives. Tell me whether you agree. What he said surprised me. In the last example, the whole clause functions as the subject.

queries: Why do some verbs take "object + to-infinitive"?
Qaysi fe’llardan keyin “object + to-infinitive” keladi?
I want him to come qanday tuzilgan?
Verb + someone + to do qoidasini izohla.
Ask, tell, want fe’llarida object qayerda turadi?

questions.en: Why do some verbs take "object + to-infinitive"?
questions.uz: Qaysi fe’llardan keyin “object + to-infinitive” keladi?

answer.uz: Ba’zi fe’llar object + to-infinitive qolipini talab qiladi; bu fe’lning lug‘aviy xususiyati. “I want you to stay.” “She asked me to help.” “They told us to wait.” Har fe’lga shu qolipni qo‘llamang: make me wait’da to yo‘q. Lug‘atdan verb patternni tekshiring.
answer.en: Some verbs license object + to-infinitive as part of their lexical pattern. Examples: I want you to stay. She asked me to help. They told us to wait. Do not generalise to all verbs: make me wait has no to. Check the dictionary pattern.

queries: Why is a gerund used after a preposition?
Prepositiondan keyin nima uchun gerund ishlatiladi?
I look forward to seeing you nega seeing?
After doing va after to do qaysi biri to‘g‘ri?
Preposition + -ing qoidasi uchun misollar ber.

questions.en: Why is a gerund used after a preposition?
questions.uz: Prepositiondan keyin nima uchun gerund ishlatiladi?

answer.uz: Prepositiondan keyin fe’l kerak bo‘lsa odatda -ing shakli keladi. “She is good at drawing.” “I left without speaking.” “I look forward to meeting you.” Oxirgisida to infinitive belgisi emas, preposition; shuning uchun meet emas meeting.
answer.en: When a verb follows a preposition, use the -ing form. Examples: She is good at drawing. I left without speaking. I look forward to meeting you. In the last sentence, to is a preposition rather than an infinitive marker.

queries: How does "stop doing" differ from "stop to do"?
“Stop doing” va “stop to do” o‘rtasidagi ma’no farqi nima?
Stop smoking bilan stop to smoke qarama-qarshimi?
Stopdan keyin -ing yoki to-infinitive qachon keladi?
Bu ikkita verb patternni misolda ajrat.

questions.en: How does "stop doing" differ from "stop to do"?
questions.uz: “Stop doing” va “stop to do” o‘rtasidagi ma’no farqi nima?

answer.uz: Stop doing — shu ishni to‘xtatish; stop to do — boshqa ishni biror maqsad uchun to‘xtatish. “He stopped smoking.” — Chekishni tashladi. “He stopped to smoke.” — Chekish uchun to‘xtadi. “We stopped walking to rest.” — Dam olish uchun yurishni to‘xtatdik.
answer.en: Stop doing means cease that activity; stop to do means pause another activity for a purpose. Examples: He stopped smoking. He stopped to smoke. We stopped walking to rest. The infinitive gives the purpose of stopping.

queries: How do "remember doing" and "remember to do" differ?
“Remember doing” va “remember to do” nimasi bilan farqlanadi?
Remember locking va remember to lock farqi nima?
Esimda qolgani bilan qilishni unutmaslikni qanday aytaman?
Rememberdan keyingi gerund/infinitive ma’nosini tushuntir.

questions.en: How do "remember doing" and "remember to do" differ?
questions.uz: “Remember doing” va “remember to do” nimasi bilan farqlanadi?

answer.uz: Remember doing — o‘tgan hodisani eslash; remember to do — kerakli ishni unutmay bajarish. “I remember locking the door.” “Remember to lock the door.” “She remembered to call.” Oxirgisi u qo‘ng‘iroq qilishni unutmaganini bildiradi.
answer.en: Remember doing recalls an earlier event; remember to do means not forgetting a required action. Examples: I remember locking the door. Remember to lock the door. She remembered to call means she did not forget the action.

queries: When do I use "try doing" instead of "try to do"?
“Try doing” bilan “try to do” o‘rtasida qanday farq bor?
Try restarting va try to restart bir xilmi?
Sinab ko‘rish va urinib ko‘rishning farqi nima?
Trydan keyin -ing yoki infinitive qachon ishlatiladi?

questions.en: When do I use "try doing" instead of "try to do"?
questions.uz: “Try doing” bilan “try to do” o‘rtasida qanday farq bor?

answer.uz: Try doing — yechim sifatida sinash; try to do — bajarishga urinish. “Try restarting the phone.” — Qayta yoqishni sinang. “I tried to open the door.” — Ochishga urindim. “Try adding less salt.” — Tuzni kamaytirishni sinang. Urinish har doim muvaffaqiyatni bildirmaydi.
answer.en: Try doing tests a possible method; try to do attempts an action. Examples: Try restarting the phone. I tried to open the door. Try adding less salt. An attempt does not by itself establish success.

queries: Why is "avoid making" correct but "avoid to make" incorrect?
Nega “avoid making” to‘g‘ri, “avoid to make” noto‘g‘ri?
Avoiddan keyin infinitive ishlatsa bo‘ladimi?
Avoid + gerund qoidasini tushuntir.
Qaysi fe’llar ortidan faqat -ing keladi?

questions.en: Why is "avoid making" correct but "avoid to make" incorrect?
questions.uz: Nega “avoid making” to‘g‘ri, “avoid to make” noto‘g‘ri?

answer.uz: Avoid fe’li ortidan boshqa fe’l kelsa -ing oladi: avoid doing. “Avoid making noise.” “She avoids driving at night.” “We avoided repeating the mistake.” To-infinitive bu qolipga mos emas; bu qoidani barcha fe’llarga ko‘chirmang.
answer.en: Avoid takes an -ing complement, not a to-infinitive. Examples: Avoid making noise. She avoids driving at night. We avoided repeating the mistake. This is the pattern for avoid, not a rule for every verb.

queries: When can "that" be omitted from a noun clause?
Noun clause’da “that”ni qachon tushirib qoldirish mumkin?
I think that he is right bilan I think he is right farqi bormi?
That omission qoidasi nima?
Complement clause’da that shart bo‘ladigan holatlarni ko‘rsat.

questions.en: When can "that" be omitted from a noun clause?
questions.uz: Noun clause’da “that”ni qachon tushirib qoldirish mumkin?

answer.uz: Ko‘p fe’llardan keyin object clause’dagi that tushishi mumkin: “I think (that) it works.” Ammo subject clause boshida that odatda kerak: “That he left surprised me.” “She said (that) she was ready.” Tushirish gapni noaniq qilsa thatni saqlang.
answer.en: That is often optional in object complement clauses but normally retained in a clause used as subject. Examples: I think (that) it works. That he left surprised me. She said (that) she was ready. Retain that when omission creates ambiguity.

queries: How do I pick the right meaning of "bank" in different contexts?
“Bank” so‘zining daryo va moliya ma’nolarini kontekstda qanday ajrataman?
Bank deganda daryo qirg‘og‘imi yoki pul joyimi?
Bir so‘zning ikkita turli meaningini qanday tanlayman?
Dictionarydagi bank sensesni misolda ko‘rsat.

questions.en: How do I pick the right meaning of "bank" in different contexts?
questions.uz: “Bank” so‘zining daryo va moliya ma’nolarini kontekstda qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Bank ma’nosini atrofidagi so‘zlardan tanlang: “deposit money at the bank” — moliyaviy tashkilot; “sit on the river bank” — qirg‘oq; “bank on your help” — yordamga tayanmoq. Lug‘atda birinchi tarjimani avtomatik olmang; butun gap va so‘z turkumini tekshiring.
answer.en: Choose the sense from context: deposit money at the bank means a financial institution; sit on the river bank refers to an edge of land; bank on your help means rely on it. Check the sentence and part of speech rather than taking the first translation.

queries: How do I distinguish a noun from a verb when they look the same, as in "record"?
“Record” ot yoki fe’l bo‘lib kelganini qanday ajrataman?
Record noun va record verb qanday farqlanadi?
Bir xil yoziladigan so‘zning word classini qayerdan bilaman?
Recordning urg‘usi so‘z turkumiga qarab o‘zgaradimi?

questions.en: How do I distinguish a noun from a verb when they look the same, as in "record"?
questions.uz: “Record” ot yoki fe’l bo‘lib kelganini qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Record shakli o‘zgarmasa ham vazifasi o‘zgaradi. “Keep a record.” — Ot, /ˈrekɔːd/. “Record your voice.” — Fe’l, /rɪˈkɔːd/. “The record is accurate.” — Ot. Artikllar, ega-fe’l o‘rni va urg‘u ma’noni ajratishga yordam beradi.
answer.en: The same spelling can have different roles. Keep a record uses a noun, commonly /ˈrekɔːd/. Record your voice uses a verb, /rɪˈkɔːd/. The record is accurate uses the noun. Syntax and stress help distinguish them.

queries: How can I identify whether "practice" or "practise" is required?
“Practice” va “practise”dan qaysi birini ishlataman?
British Englishda practice nounmi?
Praktis deb yozganda qaysi variant to‘g‘ri?
US va UK spellingda practice/practise farqi qanday?

questions.en: How can I identify whether "practice" or "practise" is required?
questions.uz: “Practice” va “practise”dan qaysi birini ishlataman?

answer.uz: British Englishda practice ot, practise fe’l; American Englishda practice ikkala vazifada. “Daily practice helps.” — Ot. “I practise daily.” — Britancha fe’l. “I practice daily.” — Amerikacha fe’l. Bir matnda tanlangan imlo uslubini izchil saqlang.
answer.en: In British English, practice is the noun and practise the verb; American English uses practice for both. Examples: Daily practice helps. I practise daily. I practice daily. Keep the chosen spelling convention consistent.

queries: Why do we "make a decision" but "do homework"?
Nega “make a decision”, lekin “do homework” deyiladi?
Make va do collocationlarini chalkashtiryapman.
Decision bilan qaysi fe’l keladi?
Do/make birikmalarini qanday yodlash kerak?

questions.en: Why do we "make a decision" but "do homework"?
questions.uz: Nega “make a decision”, lekin “do homework” deyiladi?

answer.uz: Make a decision va do homework odatiy collocationlardir; make/do’ni har safar so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilib tanlab bo‘lmaydi. Uch misol: “We made a decision.” “I do my homework.” “She made a mistake.” Lug‘atdan alohida so‘zni emas, birikmani saqlang.
answer.en: These are established collocations rather than a universal translation rule. Examples: We made a decision. I do my homework. She made a mistake. Learn and check the complete phrase instead of translating make or do in isolation.

queries: How can I remember the preposition after "interested" and "depend"?
“Interested” va “depend”dan keyin qaysi preposition ishlatiladi?
Interested on deyish mumkinmi?
Depend of yoki depend on qaysi to‘g‘ri?
Dependent prepositionsni qanday o‘rganaman?

questions.en: How can I remember the preposition after "interested" and "depend"?
questions.uz: “Interested” va “depend”dan keyin qaysi preposition ishlatiladi?

answer.uz: Birikma bilan yodlang: interested in, depend on. Uch misol: “I’m interested in music.” “She is interested in learning.” “It depends on the weather.” In’dan keyingi fe’l -ing oladi; depend’dan keyin on predlogini unutmang.
answer.en: Learn the complete patterns interested in and depend on. Examples: I’m interested in music. She is interested in learning. It depends on the weather. Use -ing after the preposition in when a verb follows it.

queries: Why is "suggest going" grammatical but "suggest to go" usually isn't?
Nega “suggest going” to‘g‘ri, “suggest to go” odatda noto‘g‘ri?
Suggestdan keyin -ing keladimi?
I suggest to study xatomi?
Suggest + gerund konstruktsiyasini ko‘rsat.

questions.en: Why is "suggest going" grammatical but "suggest to go" usually isn't?
questions.uz: Nega “suggest going” to‘g‘ri, “suggest to go” odatda noto‘g‘ri?

answer.uz: Suggest odatda -ing yoki that-clause oladi. “I suggest going early.” “She suggested that we leave.” “He suggested a different route.” Oddiy taklif ma’nosida “suggest to go” ishlatmang; boshqa fe’lning infinitive qolipini bunga ko‘chirmang.
answer.en: Suggest commonly takes -ing, a that-clause or a noun phrase. Examples: I suggest going early. She suggested that we leave. He suggested a different route. Avoid transferring another verb’s to-infinitive pattern to suggest.

queries: How do silent letters affect the pronunciation of "knowledge" and "debt"?
“Knowledge” va “debt”dagi aytilmaydigan harflarni qanday bilaman?
Knowledge so‘zidagi k o‘qiladimi?
Debtning b harfi talaffuz qilinadimi?
Silent letters uchun sodda mashq ber.

questions.en: How do silent letters affect the pronunciation of "knowledge" and "debt"?
questions.uz: “Knowledge” va “debt”dagi aytilmaydigan harflarni qanday bilaman?

answer.uz: Knowledge boshidagi k va debt ichidagi b talaffuz qilinmaydi. “Knowledge is useful.” “He paid the debt.” “I know the answer.” Lug‘atdagi IPAni ko‘rib, ovozni bo‘laklab tinglang; imlodagi har harfni ovozga aylantirmang.
answer.en: The k in knowledge and b in debt are silent. Examples: Knowledge is useful. He paid the debt. I know the answer. Use dictionary IPA and audio instead of pronouncing every written letter.

queries: How can I hear the difference between /ɪ/ and /iː/?
Inglizchadagi /ɪ/ va /iː/ tovushlarini qanday ajrataman?
Ship va sheepni bir xil aytyapman.
Qisqa i va uzun i qanday talaffuz qilinadi?
Minimal pairs orqali bu tovushlarni tushuntir.

questions.en: How can I hear the difference between /ɪ/ and /iː/?
questions.uz: Inglizchadagi /ɪ/ va /iː/ tovushlarini qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: /ɪ/ va /iː/ faqat uzunlik bilan emas, unli sifati bilan ham farq qiladi. Juftlar: ship–sheep, live–leave, sit–seat. Avval qaysi birini eshitganingizni tanlang, keyin yozib qayta tinglang. RIWI matnli savoldan talaffuzingizni eshitdim deb aytmaydi.
answer.en: The contrast involves vowel quality as well as length. Practise ship–sheep, live–leave and sit–seat. Identify the heard word before recording and comparing your version. A text-only question does not allow RIWI to judge your pronunciation.

queries: Why can't I say "an advice" or "many informations"?
Nega “an advice” va “many informations” noto‘g‘ri?
Advice sanaladigan ot emasmi?
Informationga s qo‘shimchasi qo‘shish mumkinmi?
Uncountable noun bilan miqdorni qanday aytaman?

questions.en: Why can't I say "an advice" or "many informations"?
questions.uz: Nega “an advice” va “many informations” noto‘g‘ri?

answer.uz: Advice va information odatda sanalmaydigan otlar: an yoki many bilan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ishlamaydi. “She gave me some advice.” “I need a piece of information.” “We received useful information.” Alohida birlik kerak bo‘lsa a piece of yoki mos sanaladigan ot tanlang.
answer.en: Advice and information are normally uncountable. Examples: She gave me some advice. I need a piece of information. We received useful information. Use a measure phrase or another appropriate count noun for an individual item.

queries: How do I choose between "un-", "in-", "im-" and "ir-"?
Inkor prefikslari “un-, in-, im-, ir-”dan qaysi birini tanlayman?
Unpossible nega noto‘g‘ri?
Impossible va irregular qanday yasaladi?
Negative prefixes uchun umumiy qoida bormi?

questions.en: How do I choose between "un-", "in-", "im-" and "ir-"?
questions.uz: Inkor prefikslari “un-, in-, im-, ir-”dan qaysi birini tanlayman?

answer.uz: Prefiksni faqat birinchi harfga qarab yaratib bo‘lmaydi; tayyor so‘zni lug‘atdan tekshiring. Misollar: unhappy, impossible, irregular. In- ayrim tovushlar oldida im-/ir-/il- bo‘ladi, ammo har so‘z bunday prefiks olmaydi. Ma’no va amaldagi imlo ikkalasi kerak.
answer.en: Do not invent a negative prefix from the first letter alone; verify the established word. Examples: unhappy, impossible, irregular. In- has forms such as im-, ir- and il- in some words, but these patterns do not license every imagined word.

queries: How are "hopeful" and "hopeless" related to "hope"?
“Hopeful” va “hopeless” qanday ma’no farqiga ega?
Hopega -ful yoki -less qo‘shsam nima o‘zgaradi?
Suffix orqali opposite adjectivesni qanday yasayman?
Hope word family’ni misollar bilan tushuntir.

questions.en: How are "hopeful" and "hopeless" related to "hope"?
questions.uz: “Hopeful” va “hopeless” qanday ma’no farqiga ega?

answer.uz: Hope — ot/fe’l; hopeful — umidli; hopeless — umidsiz yoki juda yomon degan kontekstli sifat. “We still have hope.” “She is hopeful about the result.” “The situation seemed hopeless.” Qo‘shimcha ma’noni o‘zgartiradi; har -less so‘zi barcha kontekstda oddiy inkor emas.
answer.en: Hope is a noun/verb; hopeful and hopeless are adjectives with context-dependent meanings. Examples: We still have hope. She is hopeful about the result. The situation seemed hopeless. Learn the word family with its actual usage.

queries: How can I tell if a phrase is too informal for IELTS Writing Task 2?
Iboraning IELTS Writing Task 2 uchun haddan tashqari norasmiyligini qanday bilaman?
A bunch of degan iborani essayda ishlatsam bo‘ladimi?
Formal va informal collocationni qanday ajrataman?
Task 2 uchun mos registerdagi so‘zni qanday tanlayman?

questions.en: How can I tell if a phrase is too informal for IELTS Writing Task 2?
questions.uz: Iboraning IELTS Writing Task 2 uchun haddan tashqari norasmiyligini qanday bilaman?

answer.uz: Lug‘atdagi informal/slang labelini va birikmaning ohangini tekshiring. “Kids” o‘rniga “children”, “a lot of” o‘rniga vaziyatga qarab “many”, “stuff” o‘rniga aniq ot yozish mumkin. Murakkab sinonimni majburan qo‘shmang; ma’no va collocation saqlansin.
answer.en: Check dictionary register labels and the phrase’s tone. Depending on context, children may suit better than kids, and a precise noun better than stuff. Do not replace words with complex synonyms unless meaning and collocation remain accurate.

queries: How can I prevent the same vocabulary item from being saved under multiple senses accidentally?

Bir xil spelling, boshqa meaningni qanday saqlayman?
Vocabulary folderda ma’no va so‘z turkumini tekshirishni o‘rgat.

questions.en: How can I prevent the same vocabulary item from being saved under multiple senses accidentally?
questions.uz: Bir so‘zni turli meaning bilan adashib ikki marta saqlamaslik uchun nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Saqlashdan oldin lemma, so‘z turkumi va shu gapdagi ma’noni tekshiring. Bir ma’noni bir papkaga qayta qo‘shish bilan boshqa ma’noni saqlash boshqa narsalar. Bankning pul va qirg‘oq ma’nolarini shunchaki bir xil yozilgani uchun birlashtirmang.
answer.en: Check lemma, part of speech and contextual sense before saving. Re-saving the same sense differs from storing another sense. Do not merge financial bank and river bank merely because their spelling is identical.

queries: Does adding five words automatically mean I have mastered five words?

So‘zni saqlash mastery hisoblanadimi?
Yodlangan so‘z bilan shunchaki saqlangan so‘zni qanday ajrataman?

questions.en: Does adding five words automatically mean I have mastered five words?
questions.uz: Besh so‘zni papkaga qo‘shish ularni o‘rgandim deganimi?

answer.uz: Yo‘q 🙂 Saqlash — keyin o‘rganish uchun yozuv qo‘shish; mastery — eslab topish va qo‘llashga oid tasdiqlangan natija. Besh so‘zni tarjimasiz eslang, gapda ishlating va keyingi kuni yana tekshiring. Coin ham faqat saqlangan son bilan tenglashtirilmaydi.
answer.en: No 🙂 Saving adds an item for study; mastery requires evidence of recall and use. Retrieve five words without translations, use them in sentences and check them later. Do not equate a saved-word count with verified mastery or its reward.

Recognition bor, recall yo‘q, qanday mashq qilay?

questions.en: How can I use a word correctly when I recognise it but cannot recall it?
questions.uz: So‘zni ko‘rsam taniyman, lekin mustaqil eslay olmayman, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Tanib qolishdan faol eslashga o‘ting: inglizcha izoh yoki bo‘sh gapdan so‘zni toping, o‘z gapingizni tuzing, keyin lug‘atdan tekshiring. Noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ma’no va birikmani tuzatib qayta eslang. Faqat ro‘yxatni qayta o‘qish yetmasligi mumkin.
answer.en: Move from recognition to retrieval: produce the word from a definition or gap, write your own sentence, then check the dictionary. Correct the sense or collocation and retrieve it again. Rereading alone may not solve a recall problem.

questions.en: How do I practise a new word without first looking at its Uzbek translation?
questions.uz: Yangi so‘zni o‘zbekcha tarjimasiga qaramay qanday mashq qilaman?

answer.uz: Avval so‘zning inglizcha sodda izohi, rasmiy bo‘lmagan vaziyat yoki bo‘sh gapdan ma’noni eslang. Keyin gap tuzing va tarjima bilan tekshiring. Taxminni tekshirilmagan ma’no qilib saqlamang; tushunmasangiz o‘zbekcha izohdan foydalanish mumkin.
answer.en: Try an English definition, situation or gap before checking the Uzbek translation. Produce a sentence, then verify it. Do not store an unchecked guess as the meaning; using Uzbek for clarification remains useful.

questions.en: Why can a dictionary synonym sound unnatural in a particular sentence?
questions.uz: Lug‘atda sinonim bo‘lsa ham gapda nega g‘alati eshitilishi mumkin?

answer.uz: Sinonimlar barcha gapda almashmaydi: register, ma’no nozikligi va collocation farq qiladi. “Strong tea”, “heavy rain”, “make a decision”ni butun birikma sifatida o‘rganing. Lug‘atdagi mos sense va misollarni tekshirmasdan har o‘xshash tarjimani qo‘ymang.
answer.en: Synonyms are not interchangeable in every context. Sense, register and collocation differ. Learn strong tea, heavy rain and make a decision as phrases. Check the relevant sense and examples before substituting a word.

questions.en: How do I move newly collected article vocabulary into a topic-based folder?
questions.uz: Articledan olingan so‘zlarni mavzuli papkaga qanday tartiblayman?

answer.uz: Article lug‘ati oynasida so‘zlarni tanlang, Add to vocabulary orqali mavjud mavzuli folderni tanlang yoki mos nom bilan yangisini oching. Keyin Vocabulary’da so‘zlar va ma’nolar saqlanganini tekshiring. Papka nomi so‘z ma’nosini o‘zgartirmaydi.
answer.en: Choose article words, use Add to vocabulary and select an existing topic folder or name a new one. Then verify the saved items and senses in Vocabulary. A folder name does not change an item’s meaning.

queries: How can I create three sentences with the same word in different grammatical forms?

Bir so‘zning turli shakllarini nutqda qanday qo‘llayman?

questions.en: How can I create three sentences with the same word in different grammatical forms?
questions.uz: Bitta so‘zni uch xil grammatik shaklda ishlatib qanday gap tuzaman?

answer.uz: Avval lug‘atdan shu word familyning haqiqiy shakllarini tekshiring; har so‘z uch shaklga ega emas. Misol: “We decide together.” — Fe’l. “The decision was difficult.” — Ot. “She gave a decisive answer.” — Sifat. Har gapda yangi shaklning vazifasini ko‘ring.
answer.en: Check that the word family actually has the required forms; not every word does. Examples: We decide together. The decision was difficult. She gave a decisive answer. Identify the verb, noun and adjective role in each sentence.

queries: How should I review a word I keep getting wrong in vocabulary games?

Bir so‘zni har safar noto‘g‘ri belgilayapman.
Game xatosini revisionga qanday aylantiraman?
Qayta-qayta xato bo‘layotgan word uchun mikro mashq ber.

questions.en: How should I review a word I keep getting wrong in vocabulary games?
questions.uz: Vocabulary o‘yinida doim xato qilayotgan so‘zni qanday qayta o‘rganaman?

answer.uz: O‘yin xatosini ma’no, imlo yoki collocation deb ajrating. So‘zni to‘g‘ri ma’nosi bilan ko‘ring, tarjimasiz eslang, o‘z gapingizni yozing va birozdan keyin yana tekshiring. Bir xatoni tez-tez qaytarish o‘rniga xato sababini tuzating.
answer.en: Classify the error as sense, spelling or collocation. Check the item, retrieve it without translation, write a personal sentence and revisit it later. Change the mistaken association rather than repeating the same unsuccessful guess.

queries: How should I interpret a very high result from a short placement test?
Qisqa placement testdan juda yuqori daraja chiqsa, uni qanday talqin qilaman?
17 savolni yechib C2 chiqdi, bu qanchalik ishonchli?
Short diagnostic bilan haqiqiy CEFR darajasi bir xilmi?
Mini test yuqori chiqsa yana nimani tekshirish kerak?

questions.en: How should I interpret a very high result from a short placement test?
questions.uz: Qisqa placement testdan juda yuqori daraja chiqsa, uni qanday talqin qilaman?

answer.uz: Qisqa placement natijasi dastlabki yo‘nalish, to‘liq CEFR sertifikati emas. Savollar soni, qamrab olingan skill va taxminiy javoblarni tekshiring. Yuqori natijani Writing/Speaking namunalari va uzunroq tushunish vazifasi bilan tekshirmasdan haqiqiy C2 deb e’lon qilmang.
answer.en: A short placement result is an initial indication, not a full CEFR certification. Check test length, skills covered and guessed answers. Validate a high result using productive tasks and broader comprehension before treating it as confirmed C2 ability.

questions.en: How can I tell whether my placement score was affected by guessing on MCQs?
questions.uz: Placement MCQ savollarida taxmin qilib topganim natijaga qanday ta’sir qiladi?

answer.uz: Taxminiy to‘g‘ri javobni bilgan javobdan keyin ajrating: javob sababini variantsiz tushuntira olasizmi? O‘xshash yangi savolda tekshiring. MCQdagi tasodifiy topish natijani oshirishi mumkin; aniq nechta javob tasodifiyligini matndan hisoblab bera olmayman.
answer.en: After the test, explain each uncertain answer without the choices and try a fresh equivalent item. Guessing can inflate an MCQ result, but the text alone cannot reveal exactly how many correct answers were accidental.

queries: How can I find which skill lowered my placement result the most?

Mini diagnosticdagi skill gapni qanday ajrataman?
Placement natijasidagi eng zaif bo‘limni qanday topaman?

questions.en: How can I find which skill lowered my placement result the most?
questions.uz: Placement testda qaysi ko‘nikma umumiy natijamni tushirganini qanday bilaman?

answer.uz: Natija sahifasidagi skill breakdownni solishtiring, faqat umumiy balga qaramang. Past aniqlik va takroriy xato ko‘p bo‘lgan skillga kichik mashq tanlang. Har bo‘lim savollari turlicha bo‘lsa foiz va savol sonini birga ko‘ring; natijangizsiz eng zaif skillni taxmin qilmayman.
answer.en: Compare the skill breakdown, considering accuracy and question count rather than total score alone. Start with a small exercise targeting recurring errors. Without your actual results, I cannot identify which skill lowered the score most.

questions.en: When should I use a seven-day plan instead of a thirty-day plan?
questions.uz: Qachon 7 kunlik, qachon 30 kunlik study plan tanlashim kerak?

answer.uz: 7 kunlik reja qisqa maqsad yoki odatni sinash uchun, 30 kunlik reja muntazam rivojlantirish uchun qulay. Vaqt va vazifa hajmi bajariladigan bo‘lsin. Reja davomiyligi ma’lum band yoki darajaga yetishni kafolatlamaydi; bir haftadan so‘ng yuklamani qayta baholang.
answer.en: A seven-day plan suits a short goal or trial routine; thirty days supports sustained practice. Choose a workload you can complete. Plan length does not guarantee a band or level; reassess the workload after a week.

queries: What if a daily plan assigns a test I have already completed?

questions.en: What if a daily plan assigns a test I have already completed?
questions.uz: Kunlik rejamga allaqachon tugatgan test yana tushsa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Vazifa nomi bir xilmi, content va urinish boshqa emasmi, tekshiring. Rejada turishi qayta bajarish foydali review bo‘lishi ham, takroriy tayinlash bo‘lishi ham mumkin. Sanasi va completed holatini qayd qilib Supportga bildiring; bajarilmagan vazifani o‘zingizcha completed deb olmang.
answer.en: Check whether the title, content and attempt are actually the same. A repeated task might be review or duplicate assignment. Report its date and completion status if unexpected; do not mark an unperformed task complete merely because a similar one was done.

questions.en: How do I report that my plan lists two full Listening tests instead of one?
questions.uz: Rejamda bitta o‘rniga ikkita full Listening test chiqsa, qanday xabar beraman?

answer.uz: Reja sanasi, Full Listening vazifalari nomi va kutilgan sonni yozing. Ikki xil testmi yoki bir xil vazifa ikki marta ko‘ringanmi, tekshiring. Supportga “kutilgan 1, ko‘ringan 2” deb aniq xabar bering; RIWI chatdagi gap bilan rejani o‘zgartirmaydi.
answer.en: Record the plan date, task names and expected count. Check whether they are distinct tests or a duplicate display. Report expected one, observed two to Support; describing it in RIWI does not edit the plan.

queries: How can I distinguish Sunday full Reading from weekday single passages?

questions.en: How can I distinguish Sunday full Reading from weekday single passages?
questions.uz: Yakshanbadagi Full Reading bilan boshqa kunlardagi bitta passage vazifasini qanday ajrataman?

answer.uz: Full Reading to‘liq to‘plamni, single passage bitta matnni bildiradi. Rejadagi vazifa hajmi, sana va havola ochadigan sahifani tekshiring. Yakshanba uchun ko‘rsatilgan full bilan ish kunidagi bitta passage’ni bir xil vaqtli vazifa deb hisoblamang.
answer.en: Full Reading refers to a complete set; a single passage is one text. Check the assigned date, workload and destination page. A Sunday full-test assignment and a weekday passage should not be treated as identical workloads.

questions.en: Why might a plan include Writing Grammar instead of an essay exam?
questions.uz: Study plan’da ba’zan essay o‘rniga Writing Grammar chiqishi nimaga xizmat qiladi?

answer.uz: Writing Grammar gap aniqligi va tuzilmani mashq qiladi, essay esa fikrni to‘liq tashkil etishni tekshiradi. Grammatik xato ko‘p bo‘lsa maqsadli mashqdan keyin paragrafda qo‘llash foydali. Har kuni to‘liq essay shart emas; ikkisini maqsad bilan bog‘lang.
answer.en: Writing Grammar targets sentence control; an essay combines argument and organisation. After targeted grammar practice, apply the form in a paragraph. A full essay every day is not inherently necessary; connect the activities to your learning need.

questions.en: What should I do when yesterday's study-plan task is still unfinished?
questions.uz: Kechagi study plan vazifam bitmagan bo‘lsa, bugungi rejani qanday boshlayman?

answer.uz: Avval eng muhim bitmagan vazifani va bugungi real vaqtingizni belgilang. Kichik qismini tugatib, keyin bugungi ustuvor vazifaga o‘ting; hammasini bir kunga tiqishtirmang. Rejani ko‘chirish ruxsati bo‘lmasa RIWI u avtomatik o‘zgardi deb aytmaydi.
answer.en: Identify the most important unfinished item and today’s available time. Finish a manageable portion, then address today’s priority. Avoid overloading one day; do not assume RIWI has rescheduled the plan without an authorised change.

queries: What is the difference between completing a study-plan link and completing the actual exercise?

questions.en: What is the difference between completing a study-plan link and completing the actual exercise?
questions.uz: Study plan havolasini ochish bilan mashqni tugatishning farqi nima?

answer.uz: Havolani ochish — sahifaga kirish; tugatish — mashqning kerakli javoblari va yakunlash amali serverda qabul qilinishi. Completed/result holatini tekshiring. Faqat link bosilgani skill o‘zlashtirildi yoki coin berildi degani emas.
answer.en: Opening a link visits a page; completing the exercise requires its required work and accepted final action. Verify completed/result status. A click alone does not prove mastery, completion or a coin award.

questions.en: How should I interpret a mock Speaking upload that shows no submitted audio?
questions.uz: Mock Speaking uchun audio tanladim, lekin submitted ko‘rinmasa, nima qilaman?

answer.uz: Fayl tanlash, upload va Submit alohida bosqich bo‘lishi mumkin. Avval tanlangan audio nomi va previewni, so‘ng yuborish natijasi va submitted holatini tekshiring. Statussiz “topshirildi” deb hisoblamang; qayta urinishdan oldin audio nusxasini saqlang.
answer.en: Selecting a file, uploading and submitting may be separate steps. Check the filename/preview, the submission response and submitted status. Without confirmation, do not assume it was submitted; preserve a copy before retrying.

queries: Why might a progress chart differ from the tasks listed in my plan?

Progressdagi recorded activity bilan planned taskni qanday ajrataman?

questions.en: Why might a progress chart differ from the tasks listed in my plan?
questions.uz: My Progress grafigi bilan study plan vazifalari nega bir-biriga mos kelmasligi mumkin?

answer.uz: Study plan — tayinlangan ish, Progress — yozib olingan faoliyat/natija. Havolani ochish, vazifa tugashi va baho tayyorligi har xil hodisa. Bir xil sana va modul filtrini solishtiring, so‘ng yo‘q natijaning aniq statusini tekshiring.
answer.en: A study plan lists assigned work; Progress records activity/results. Opening a link, completing a task and receiving a grade are distinct. Compare the same dates and module filters, then inspect the missing result’s status.

queries: What should I check if an exam timer finishes but no result appears?

questions.en: What should I check if an exam timer finishes but no result appears?
questions.uz: Mock vaqti tugadi, lekin result ko‘rinmasa, nimani tekshiraman?

answer.uz: Taymer nol bo‘lishi auto-submit muvaffaqiyatini isbotlamaydi. Internet, visible submitted status va xato xabarini tekshiring; tugallanmagan javob nusxasini saqlang. Baho kechikishi bilan topshirish xatosini ajrating va urinish nomi/vaqti bilan Supportga murojaat qiling.
answer.en: A zero timer does not prove successful auto-submission. Check connection, submitted status and errors, preserving a copy of work. Distinguish delayed grading from failed submission and report the attempt and time.

queries: How do I distinguish a submitted mock from a fully graded mock?
Mock “submitted” bo‘lsa, bu “graded” deganimi?

questions.en: How do I distinguish a submitted mock from a fully graded mock?
questions.uz: Mock “submitted” bo‘lsa, bu “graded” deganimi?

answer.uz: Submitted — javoblar qabul qilingan; graded — tegishli baholash yakunlangan. Objective bo‘lim natijasi chiqib, Writing/Speaking hali kutilayotgan bo‘lishi mumkin. Har skill statusini tekshiring; qabul qilingan ishni yakuniy tekshirilgan band bilan tenglashtirmang.
answer.en: Submitted means responses were received; graded means the relevant assessment finished. Objective sections may have results while Writing or Speaking is pending. Check each skill’s status rather than treating submission as a final band.

queries: How do I prioritise the next task when a plan contains several skills?

Reading, Speaking va Grammar bor, tartibini qanday tanlay?

questions.en: How do I prioritise the next task when a plan contains several skills?
questions.uz: Study planda bir kunda bir nechta skill bo‘lsa, qaysisidan boshlayman?

answer.uz: Avval muddati yaqin yoki eng zaif skilldagi muhim vazifani tanlang, keyin vaqtga sig‘adigan kichik bloklarga bo‘ling. Masalan: 15 daqiqa grammar, bitta passage, qisqa Speaking. Bu shaxsiy mashq taklifi; mavjud planni avtomatik almashtirmaydi.
answer.en: Prioritise an urgent task or a weak skill, then divide the work into realistic blocks. For example: fifteen minutes of grammar, one passage and brief speaking practice. This is study advice, not an automatic change to your assigned plan.

queries: Why does finishing one of nine Listening tasks award less than completing all nine?

Bitta Listening mashqini tugatish rewardga qanday ta’sir qiladi?

questions.en: Why does finishing one of nine Listening tasks award less than completing all nine?
questions.uz: To‘qqizta Listening taskdan bittasini tugatsam, coin qanday hisoblanadi?

answer.uz: Hozirgi qoida Listeningdagi har yangi tasdiqlangan activity completion uchun alohida coin yozadi; 1/9 bilan 9/9 bir xil emas. Bir xil completionni qayta yuborish yana tanga bermaydi. Aniq balans va olingan rewardni wallet qaydidan tekshiring; clientdagi hisoblagichning o‘zi dalil emas.
answer.en: Current Listening rewards are recorded per newly verified activity completion, so 1/9 differs from 9/9. Repeating the same completion does not pay again. Check the wallet ledger for the actual award rather than relying solely on a browser counter.

queries: Why might I earn no coins after leaving an exercise early?
Mashqdan erta chiqsam, nega coin berilmasligi mumkin?
Testni bitirmay back qildim, tanga kelmadi.
Early exitda reward hisoblanadimi?
Mashqni tugatmasdan chiqish bilan completed holati farqi nima?

questions.en: Why might I earn no coins after leaving an exercise early?
questions.uz: Mashqdan erta chiqsam, nega coin berilmasligi mumkin?

answer.uz: Erta chiqishda mashq yakunlanganligi serverda tasdiqlanmagan bo‘lishi mumkin. Reward uchun faqat sahifada bo‘lish emas, tegishli completion dalili kerak. Qoralamani saqlash, javob yuborish va coin yozilishi alohida holatlar; wallet va mashq statusini tekshiring.
answer.en: Leaving early may mean the server never verified completion. Time on the page alone is not the required completion evidence. Draft saving, answer submission and coin recording are separate; check the exercise status and wallet.

answer.en: A prepared parent message is a draft; an explicit Send action and successful server response provide sending evidence. Automatic notifications follow a separate event/configuration. Use only your role’s authorised workflow; RIWI chat does not message parents for you.
